The Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the Information Brochure for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027, inviting applications for Intake 01/2027 under the Agnipath Scheme. Unmarried male candidates who have passed Matriculation and meet the required age and medical standards can apply for this four-year engagement in the Hospitality or Housekeeping stream. Below is a quick summary of the key facts, followed by complete details on eligibility, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

  • Recruiting Organization: Indian Air Force (IAF)
  • Post: Agniveervayu Non-Combatant (Intake 01/2027), under the Agnipath Scheme
  • Number of Vacancies: Not specified in the brochure 
  • Who Can Apply: Unmarried male candidates born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009, who have passed Matriculation/equivalent and meet the mandatory medical standards
  • Application Mode: Offline - application form to be downloaded from the official web portal and submitted by post/drop box
  • Last Date to Apply: 17 August 2026
  • Official Web Portal: Check Here

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027 Notification Out

The Information Brochure for Agniveervayu Non-Combatant, Intake 01/2027, has been published by the Indian Air Force. It carries full details of eligibility, job profile, application procedure, terms of service, and the sequence of examination. Candidates are advised to read the complete brochure carefully before filling the application form.

  • Web Portal for Application Forms and Details: Check Here
  • Notification PDF Direct Link: Information Brochure | Guidelines to Fill Application Forms Agniveervayu Non-Combatants

IAF Agniveervayu Recruitment 2027 Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Indian Air Force (IAF)
Scheme Agnipath Scheme
Post Agniveervayu Non-Combatant
Intake 01/2027
Streams Hospitality Stream, Housekeeping Stream
Engagement Period 4 years, under the Air Force Act 1950
Application Mode Offline (post/drop box)
Last Date to Apply 17 August 2026

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date for Receipt of Application 17 August 2026

The brochure also refers candidates to the Employment News notification for the exact due date applicable to the location where the application is submitted; the date given in the introductory section of the brochure is 17 August 2026.

Also read: Indian Army NCC Special Entry 125 Course (Women) Notification Out: Eligibility, Salary, Apply Online

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Vacancy Details

The brochure does not specify a numeric vacancy count for Agniveervayu Non-Combatant, Intake 01/2027. It instead lists more than 130 application and drop-box locations across India, each falling under one or both of two streams - Hospitality and Housekeeping. For a number of locations under HQ WAC (Western Air Command), the brochure explicitly states that the "Vacancy in Stream will be updated shortly." Candidates should check the official web portal for any update on vacancy numbers closer to the selection process.

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Eligibility Criteria

Age Limit

Candidates born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply. If a candidate clears all stages of the selection procedure, the upper age limit as on the date of enrolment should be 22 years.

Marital Status

Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for enrolment as Agniveervayu Non-Combatant. Candidates must give an undertaking not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Any Agniveervayu Non-Combatant who marries during this period will be dismissed from service. Only unmarried Agniveervayu Non-Combatant will be eligible for later selection in the regular cadre as NC(E). Candidates must sign a voluntary undertaking accepting this condition at the time of enrolment.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Matriculation/equivalent examination from an Education Board recognised by the Central Government, a State Government, or a Union Territory, as on the date of registration.

Mandatory Medical Standards

Parameter Standard
Height Minimum acceptable height 152 cm
Chest Minimum range of expansion 5 cm
Weight Proportionate to height and age, as applicable for IAF
Visual Acuity 6/36 in each eye, correctable to 6/9 in each eye; colour vision CP-III; refractive error not exceeding +3.5D including astigmatism; corneal surgery (PRK/LASIK) not acceptable
Hearing Normal hearing - able to hear forced whisper from 6 metres with each ear separately
Dental Healthy gums, good set of teeth, minimum 14 dental points; dental implants/implant-supported prosthesis not awarded dental points; fixed or removable orthodontic appliances lead to unfit status
General Health Must be fit for the Air Force, of normal anatomy without loss of any appendage, free from active/latent or acute/chronic medical or surgical disability, communicable disease, infection, or skin ailments
Gender Candidates found with predominant characteristics of the opposite gender on external physical examination will be rejected; candidates who have undergone gender reassignment surgery will be declared unfit

The brochure clarifies that the above medical standards are broad guidelines only; final medical fitness will be conclusively decided by the Medical Board.

General Disqualifications

  • Consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (banned under the NDPS Act 1985) is a rejection criterion for selection, and a ground for disciplinary action including dismissal if found after enrolment. The IAF follows a zero-tolerance policy on alcoholism and substance abuse.
  • Permanent body tattoos are not permitted, except on the inner forearm (elbow to wrist), the back/reverse side of the hand, or tribal tattoos as per custom and tradition. Offensive, obscene, indecent, sexist, or racist tattoos are prohibited anywhere on the body. The Selection Centre has the final say on whether a tattoo is acceptable.
  • Only Sikh candidates whose religion prohibits cutting hair or shaving are permitted to grow hair and/or retain a beard and moustache.

Job Profile for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant

Selected candidates will be required to perform duties under either the Hospitality or Housekeeping stream, in addition to any specific duties assigned in organisational interest.

  • Hospitality Stream: Cooking, kitchen management, presentation of dishes, maintaining a clean and orderly kitchen, safe storage of food and other items, handling crockery/cutlery/refrigeration, laying tables/chairs, and serving food and water.
  • Housekeeping Stream: Cleaning of floors, roads, rooms, bathrooms, commodes, and urinals; making brooms; cutting grass/hedges; ground levelling and digging trenches; watering gardens; washing utensils and clothes; filling and carrying water; handling office equipment; and additionally, hair cutting, shaving, head massage, ironing clothes, stitching or repair of leather items, shoe polishing, and cutting/stitching/altering garments.

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Salary and Benefits

Agniveervayu Non-Combatant recruited under this scheme will be paid an Agniveer package of ₹30,000 per month with a fixed yearly increment, along with risk and hardship allowances (as applicable in IAF), dress and travel allowances, and perks such as ration, clothing, accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per existing rules.

Seva Nidhi Package (Terminal Benefit)

Year Monthly Customised Package (₹) In Hand - 70% (₹) Contribution to Agniveer Corpus Fund - 30% (₹) Matching GoI Contribution (₹)
1st Year 30,000 21,000 9,000 9,000
2nd Year 33,000 23,100 9,900 9,900
3rd Year 36,500 25,550 10,950 10,950
4th Year 40,000 28,000 12,000 12,000

After four years, the total contribution to the Agniveer Corpus Fund is approximately ₹5.02 lakh from the individual and a matching ₹5.02 lakh from the Government of India, giving an approximate exit amount of ₹10.04 lakh as the Seva Nidhi package (absolute amount, excluding interest). Agniveervayu Non-Combatant are not required to contribute to any Provident Fund, and there is no entitlement to gratuity or any pensionary benefit.

Other Benefits

  • Leave: 30 days of annual leave per year; sick leave based on medical advice by a competent medical authority.
  • Medical and CSD Facilities: Entitled to medical facility at service hospitals and CSD provisions during the engagement period.
  • Insurance: Non-contributory life insurance cover of ₹48 lakh for the duration of the engagement period.
  • Agniveer Skill Certificate: A detailed skill-set certificate is provided at the end of the engagement period, highlighting skills and competency acquired.

On completion of four years of service, Agniveervayu Non-Combatant may apply for permanent enrolment in the IAF as NC(E); up to 25% of each specific batch may be enrolled in the regular cadre based on objective criteria including performance, though no candidate has a right to further enrolment. Personnel enrolled under this scheme are not eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after discharge, and release at own request before completing the engagement period is not permissible except in exceptional cases with approval of the Competent Authority.

How to Apply for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027

  1. Visit the official web portal: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
  2. Go to the "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" tab and open the "Application Forms" sub-tab.
  3. Download the blank application form and the other required certificates/forms.
  4. Fill the application form as per the format hosted on the web portal; applications not in this format will be rejected.
  5. Attach the required documents (see below).
  6. Send the duly filled application by normal post or drop box to any one of the addresses listed in the brochure (the brochure lists over 130 IAF stations and drop-box locations across India, grouped by Command headquarters, each marked with the eligible stream - Hospitality and/or Housekeeping). Candidates should choose the location where they wish to apply.
  7. Ensure the application reaches the chosen address on or before the due date given in the Employment News notification (17 August 2026, as stated in the brochure).

Note: Applications received after the due date will not be accepted. Candidates submitting multiple applications will have their candidature rejected entirely. Incomplete applications, in terms of information or documents, will be rejected.

Documents Required for IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027

  • Class 10th/Matriculation mark sheet and Class 10th passing certificate
  • A recent passport-size colour photograph (not older than six months as on the last date of receipt of application), front portrait in a light background without headgear (except for Sikhs), taken while holding a black slate bearing the candidate's name and the date the photo was taken, written clearly in white chalk in capital letters. Two copies of the same photo must be retained for submission at the time of enrolment.
  • Consent certificate signed by parents/legal guardian, for candidates below 18 years of age; candidates above 18 years must sign a self-consent certificate
  • A self-addressed envelope with a ten-rupee stamp affixed

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Selection Process

Candidates whose applications are accepted will be issued admit cards for the written test, which will state the date, location, and time of the test. The selection process has four phases:

Phase I - Written Test

The written test is common for both streams and will be conducted at the station/location where the candidate submitted the application.

Subject Marks Minimum Pass Marks
General English (Class 10th level) 15 5
General Knowledge (Class 10th level) 15 5
Total 30 15 (50% of aggregate)

Candidates reporting for the written test must carry their Aadhaar card (candidates from Jammu & Kashmir, Assam, and Meghalaya may carry another valid ID if they do not have an Aadhaar card), a character certificate signed by a Gazetted Officer/Panchayat Officer/School Principal/College Principal (not older than 6 months, with office seal), the original 10th/Matriculation passing certificate (or a DigiLocker-verified printout), the original 10th marksheet, and an experience certificate if any. Candidates found using unfair means, carrying prohibited electronic devices, or engaging in impersonation will be debarred permanently from Agniveervayu Non-Combatant selection tests.

Phase II - Physical Fitness Test (PFT)

Only candidates who pass the written test are permitted to appear for PFT, which is common and qualifying for both streams.

  • Height Check: Minimum acceptable height 152 cm; candidates below this are disqualified from further tests.
  • PFT-I: A 1.6 km run to be completed within 7 minutes (additional time is given at high altitude: nil up to 5,000 feet, +30 seconds from 5,001–9,000 feet, +120 seconds from 9,001–12,000 feet).
  • PFT-II: 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups, and 20 squats, each to be completed within 1 minute, with rest breaks of 10 minutes (after the run), 2 minutes (after push-ups), and 2 minutes (after sit-ups) between tests.

Phase III - Stream Suitability Test (SST)

The SST is qualifying in nature. Candidates must be willing to undergo training and perform any task associated with their opted stream; unwillingness to perform a task leads to disqualification in SST. For the Hospitality stream, candidates are assessed on cooking-related skills, kitchen sanitation and hygiene, serving food/water/beverages, personal hygiene, and knowledge of kitchen fire/safety precautions. For the Housekeeping stream, candidates are assessed on sweeping floors/cleaning bathrooms, cutting grass/watering gardens/digging trenches, washing utensils, and demonstrated ability in at least one of washing and ironing clothes, hair cutting/dressing/shampooing, stitching of leather items, or tailoring/pattern-cutting skills.

Phase IV - Medical Examination

A certain number of candidates who qualify in SST, as per merit, undergo a medical examination by the Air Force Medical team as per IAF medical standards. This includes baseline investigations such as Blood Haemogram (Hb, TLC, DLC, Platelets), Urine RE/ME, Biochemistry (blood sugar fasting and post-prandial, serum cholesterol, RFT, LFT), chest radiograph (PA view), ECG, and any other investigation the Recruiting Medical Officer considers necessary. The Recruiting Medical Officer and Armed Forces specialist doctors are the final authority on fitness; there is no provision for representation or review after a candidate is declared unfit.

IAF Agniveervayu Non-Combatant Recruitment 2027: Important Instructions

  • Selection in the Indian Air Force is fair, transparent, and merit-based only; no bribe is required at any stage.
  • Candidates not reporting for the written test at or before the cut-off time will not be permitted to appear.
  • Candidates should be prepared to stay for the entire duration of the tests at their own expense; no TA/DA is admissible.
  • Mobile phones, smart watches, and electronic gadgets are not permitted in the examination hall.
  • Original educational mark sheets/passing certificates are compulsory for the selection test; candidates with DigiLocker-verified certificates may appear provisionally and must produce originals within a specified time.
  • Candidates should get dental tartar and stains removed and clear ear wax before the medical examination, and should be prepared to stay for four to five days (own arrangement) for the medical test.
  • If there is any variation between the English and Hindi versions of the notification, the English version is authentic.
  • The Indian Air Force reserves the right to cancel the entire selection process at any stage, without assigning any reason.
  • Data entered in the application form is treated as final; no changes are permitted later, and wrong data entry will disqualify the candidature.

SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 05 August 2026 on the official website sjvn.nic.in. A total of 21 vacancies have been announced for the posts of Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager, and Engineer through Advertisement No. 127/2026.

Candidates aged 18 years to 55 years (post-wise upper age limit applicable) who possess a full-time Bachelor's Degree in the relevant Engineering discipline or M.Sc. (Chemistry), along with the prescribed post-qualification experience, are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process for SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 will commence on 05 August 2026 and will remain open until 26 August 2026 (11:59 PM).

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

SJVN Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has officially released Advertisement No. 127/2026 inviting online applications for 21 posts of Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager, and Engineer across Electrical, Mechanical, C&I, and Chemical disciplines for its wholly owned subsidiary STPL, executing the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, Bihar. The official notification contains complete details regarding vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, experience requirements, age limit, salary, application fee, selection process, important dates, and application procedure. Candidates are advised to read the detailed notification carefully before submitting their online applications.

  • Download SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF
  • SJVN Official Website

SJVN Limited Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview

SJVN Limited, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Power, Government of India, has invited online applications through Advertisement No. 127/2026 for 21 posts of Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager and Engineer across Electrical, Mechanical, C&I and Chemical disciplines. These posts are for SJVN's fully owned subsidiary STPL, which is executing the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online at the official SJVN website, www.sjvn.nic.in, from 05/08/2026 up to 26/08/2026.

Particulars Details
Organisation SJVN Limited (A Joint Venture of Govt. of India & Govt. of Himachal Pradesh)
Advertisement Number Advt. No. 127/2026
Posts Advertised Chief General Manager, Deputy Manager, Engineer
Total Vacancies 21
Project 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, Bihar (through subsidiary STPL)
Mode of Application Online only
Official Website www.sjvn.nic.in
Closing Date for Online Application 26/08/2026 (11:59 PM)

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

Activity Date
Commencement of Online Registration 05/08/2026 (10:00 AM onwards)
Closing date for submitting applications through the website 26/08/2026 (11:59 PM)
Last date for receipt of application printout, payment receipt and certificates at SJVN Office 15/09/2026

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 21 posts are available across four engineering disciplines. The table below gives the post-wise vacancy break-up.

Note: As per the official notification, the number of posts is tentative and can be changed at the absolute discretion of SJVN Management as per requirement. Vacancies may also vary depending on the actual need at the time of selection.

Category-wise reservation (including backlog) across levels is as follows:

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

SJVN Educational Qualification

Discipline Designation/Level Essential Educational Qualification
Electrical/Mechanical Chief General Manager / E8(a) Full time regular bachelor degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University/Institution of India
Mechanical Dy Manager/E4, Engineer/E2 Full time regular bachelor degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University/Institution of India
Electrical Dy Manager/E4, Engineer/E2 Full time regular bachelor degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering from a recognized University/Institution of India
C&I Dy Manager/E4, Engineer/E2 Full time regular bachelor degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics/Instrumentation & Control/Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering from a recognized University/Institution of India
Chemical Dy Manager/E4, Engineer/E2 Full time regular bachelor degree in Chemical Engineering or M.Sc (Chemistry) from a recognized University/Institution of India

Candidates from the SC/ST/PwBD categories must have scored 50% or more marks, while candidates in other categories need 55% or more marks in the essential qualification. Rounding off of percentage is not permitted; for example, 54.99% will not be considered as 55%.

SJVN Age Limit

Level Upper Age Limit (as on closing date)
E8(a) - Chief General Manager 55 years
E4 - Deputy Manager 36 years
E2 - Engineer 32 years

Minimum age for all posts is 18 years, and applicants must be Indian Nationals. Upper age limit inclusive of all relaxations shall not exceed 55 years.

SJVN Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation

PwBD (OBC-NCL) 13 years
PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years
Jammu & Kashmir domiciled candidates (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989) 5 years
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) As per Government of India guidelines

Age relaxation for PwBD candidates is applicable irrespective of whether the post is reserved for that category, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBD. There is no upper age bar for internal applicants of SJVN.

SJVN Experience Requirements

All posts require relevant post-qualification executive experience in Erection/Commissioning and/or Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of Coal-based Thermal Power Plants, including specific experience in Super Critical Thermal Power Plants of minimum 660 MW capacity.

Level Minimum Total Experience Minimum Super Critical TPP (660MW+) Experience
E8(a) - Chief General Manager 27 years 8 years
E4 - Deputy Manager 7 years 3 years
E2 - Engineer 3 years 1 year

SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of one year in total experience where the requirement is more than three years.

Additional criteria for candidates from Government/CPSE background: Should be working in the equivalent IDA pay scale for at least the last 4 years (E8(a): Rs. 1,20,000-3%-2,80,000; E4/E2: Rs. 60,000-3%-1,80,000 or equivalent).

Additional criteria for candidates from Private Sector:

  • CTC should not be less than Rs. 27 Lakhs per annum for E8(a) posts, and not less than Rs. 13.62 Lakhs per annum for E4/E2 posts.
  • Candidate should be working in a reputed organization having a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 2,500 Crore or more (average of the three audited financial years preceding the current year).

Teaching experience, internship, apprenticeship, and pre-qualification experience will not be counted towards the required experience. Periods of sabbatical leave and extraordinary leave will also not be counted.

Mechanical D, HH; OA, OL, Dw, AAV, SD/SI (with or without associated neurological/limb dysfunction); SLD, MI; MD involving the above
C&I D, HH; OL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, SD/SI (with or without associated neurological/limb dysfunction); ASD (Mild), SLD, MI; MD involving the above
Chemical HH; OA, OL, CP, Dw, AAV, SD/SI (with or without associated neurological/limb dysfunction); SLD, MI; MD involving the above

Only PwBD candidates with a specified disability of not less than 40% are eligible for the applicable benefit of reservation/concession.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Salary Structure

Selected candidates will be placed in the following IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) pay scales:

Level Pay Scale (IDA)
E8(a) Rs. 1,20,000 - 3% - 2,80,000
E4 Rs. 70,000 - 3% - 2,00,000
E2 Rs. 50,000 - 3% - 1,60,000

In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, selected candidates will be entitled to attractive perquisites and benefits, including:

  • Allowances @ 35% of Basic Pay under the Cafeteria Approach
  • HRA / Company-leased accommodation
  • Contributory Provident Fund
  • Conveyance Reimbursement
  • Leave Encashment
  • Performance Related Pay
  • Medical Facility
  • Gratuity
  • Contributory Pension

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

  • Application fee: Rs. 500 plus GST @ 18% (non-refundable), to be paid online.
  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/EWS candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.
  • The application process is treated as complete only after submission of the application fee (where applicable).
  • Application fee is non-refundable even if the candidature is rejected for any reason.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  1. Scrutiny of applications based on the job specifications.
  2. SJVN Management reserves the right to conduct a screening test to restrict the number of candidates called for the Personal Interview, if required.
  3. If conducted, the screening test is qualifying in nature only (50% qualifying marks for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for other reserved categories) and carries no weightage in the final merit list.
  4. Document verification of shortlisted candidates.
  5. Personal Interview - final selection and merit list are based purely on marks secured in the interview.
  6. Qualifying marks in the interview: 50% for UR/EWS/ESM and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC (NCL).
  7. Candidates have the option to appear for the Personal Interview in Hindi or English.
  8. Experienced candidates with experience beyond the prescribed minimum may be considered for service weightage by the Selection Committee.

Candidates who qualify in the Personal Interview will be adjudged suitable for empanelment, and the offer of appointment will be issued in order of category-wise merit, subject to requirement and medical fitness.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (white background, max 50 KB, .jpg format)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (max 50 KB, .jpg format)
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Experience certificates clearly indicating nature of experience, along with supporting documents such as appointment letter, offer letter, joining order, confirmation letter/order, promotion order, role assignment order, transfer order, service certificate, relieving letter, and pay slips
  • Certified pay and PF slips for the last 6 months
  • Certificate from the employer confirming relevant experience and pay scale/emoluments
  • For private sector candidates: Form 16 and ITR for the last 2 financial years, last pay certificate, CTC certificate on company letterhead, and average audited annual turnover details for 3 financial years
  • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/ESM), as applicable, at the time of the Personal Interview
  • OBC (NCL) certificate in the prescribed format, issued in FY 2026-27 or within the last 6 months
  • Valid photo ID proof (original; photocopies not accepted) at the time of interview

How to Apply for SJVN Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official SJVN website: www.sjvn.nic.in
  2. Go to the Career section and register with a valid, active email ID and mobile number.
  3. Fill in all details in the online application form carefully, including qualification and experience details for each organization worked at.
  4. Upload the required photograph and signature as per the specified format and size.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted).
  6. Submit the online application before the closing date, i.e., 26/08/2026 (11:59 PM).
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application (preview) and send it along with the payment receipt, experience details and supporting certificates to the address below, so as to reach on or before 15/09/2026:

Postal Address:
Advt. No. 127/2026
O/o DGM (HR/Recruitment)
SJVN Limited, Shakti Sadan, Corporate Head Quarters,
Shanan, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh - 171006

Applications submitted online can be edited/updated until the last date of online submission; no changes are permitted after that date. Applications received in hard copy after the prescribed last date will be summarily rejected.

SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Candidates should apply online only; no other mode of submission is accepted.
  • Only one application per post is allowed.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without the requisite application fee will be rejected.
  • Where posts are not reserved for a category, reserved-category candidates may also apply under the UR category if they meet the unreserved eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates called for the Personal Interview will be reimbursed 2nd Class AC Sleeper Rail/Bus fare by the shortest route, as per SJVN rules.
  • Persons working under Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised to be cautious of fraudulent persons, agencies, or websites; SJVN does not seek any payment other than the application fee.
  • All correspondence regarding the recruitment will be through the registered e-mail ID only.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Career section of the SJVN website - no separate notification will be issued.
  • Internal applicants have no upper age bar, and internal candidates with AMIE qualification in the respective discipline are also eligible.
  • For queries, candidates may e-mail [email protected], mentioning "Advt. No. 127/2026 and Designation" in the subject line.

Candidates who have completed their engineering degree can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and PSU Recruitment 2026 opportunities across India. Candidates looking for more opportunities in the power sector can also explore the latest Himachal Pradesh Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to Bihar can check Bihar Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Chemical Engineering can also browse more Navratna PSU Jobs and Thermal Power Plant Jobs matching their qualification.

RailTel Corporation of India Limited (RailTel), a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Railways, has released the RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification (No. RCIL/2024/P&A/27/1, dated 28.07.2026) inviting applications for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961. This RailTel Apprentice Vacancy 2026 drive covers 40 posts across Graduate Engineer and Diploma Engineer categories at locations across India.

Quick answer: RailTel is recruiting Graduate Engineer and Diploma Engineer Apprentices for 40 posts (32 Graduate Engineer + 8 Diploma Engineer, computed from the notification). Eligible Indian nationals aged 18-27 years with a relevant engineering degree or diploma (aggregate 60%) can apply online through the NATS 2.0 portal at nats.education.gov.in. The application start date is not specified in the notification. The last date to apply is 27.08.2026. Postings will be at RailTel locations across the Northern, Eastern, Southern and Western regions of India, including the Corporate Office in New Delhi/Gurgaon.

  • Download RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The table below summarizes the key details of RailTel Corporation of India Limited's Apprentice Recruitment 2026 as given in the official notification.

RailTel Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

RailTel has announced apprentice engagement in two categories, with numbers described as tentative and subject to change without further notice.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Graduate Engineer Apprentice 32 (tentative)
2 Diploma Engineer Apprentice 8 (tentative)
3 Total 40 (computed)

Apprentices may be engaged at RailTel's Corporate Office in New Delhi/Gurgaon, or across Northern Region locations (including Delhi, Jaipur, Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Bareilly, Amritsar, Rohtak, Chandigarh, Jodhpur, Ajmer, Bikaner, Agra, Jhansi, Aligarh, Roorkee, Moradabad, Delhi/NCR, Kanpur, Banda, Prayagraj, Varanasi and Mau), Eastern Region locations (Kolkata, Malda, Asansol, Patna, Dhanbad, Samastipur, Sonepur, Muzaffarpur, Gaya, Ranchi, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati and New Jalpaiguri), Southern Region locations (Secunderabad, Bangalore, Chennai and Vijayawada), and Western Region locations (Nagpur, Bhopal, Ahmedabad and Mumbai). Candidates may opt for any location of their convenience, though allotment depends on RailTel's presence there; if RailTel has no presence at the chosen location, a nearby location may be allotted instead.

RailTel Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must satisfy the qualification, experience and age conditions listed below to be considered for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026.

RailTel Apprentice Qualification

Post Qualification Required
Graduate Engineer Apprentice Full-time regular 4-year Graduation in Engineering/Technology from an AICTE-approved college, with an aggregate of 60% marks, in Electronics & Telecommunication; or Telecommunication; or Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology; or Electrical Engineering; or Electronics Engineering; or any combination of engineering branches where Electronics is one of the main branches (such as Electronics & Instrumentation) - OR passed Sections A and B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examinations in the above relevant branches - OR passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India) in the above relevant branches.
Diploma Engineer Apprentice Full-time regular 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology from an AICTE-approved college, with an aggregate of 60% marks, in the same branches listed above.

Candidates who obtained their qualification through distance learning or part-time mode are not eligible to apply.

RailTel Apprentice Experience Condition

Any engineering graduate or diploma holder who has undergone, or possesses, training or job/work experience of one year or more after attaining the qualification mentioned above is not eligible. Candidates who completed their graduation or diploma more than three years ago will also not be considered for this apprenticeship. Candidates who have already completed an apprenticeship, terminated one midway, or are currently pursuing an apprenticeship with another organization are not eligible either.

RailTel Apprentice Age Limit

Category Age Limit
General 18 to 27 years, as on the date of notification (28.07.2026)
SC/ST/OBC Age relaxation as per Presidential/Governmental Directives - specific number of relaxation years not specified in the notification

Also Read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 4098 Junior Engineer Posts

RailTel Apprentice Salary (Stipend)

Selected candidates will receive a monthly consolidated stipend for the one-year apprenticeship period, shared between RailTel and the Government of India (DBT share), as shown below. No other benefit, facility, or allowance is payable apart from this consolidated stipend.

Category Monthly Stipend (₹) RailTel Share (₹) Government/DBT Share (₹)
Graduate Apprentice 14,000 9,500 4,500
Diploma Apprentice 12,000 8,000 4,000

RailTel Apprentice Selection Process

Selection for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following process as described in the notification:

  • A merit list will be prepared region/state/location-wise on receipt of online applications, with preference given to Government Institution pass-outs.
  • Shortlisting will be done based on the merit list prepared using marks obtained in the required qualification (minimum eligibility), and/or through an interview as required.
  • Only candidates found medically fit as per RailTel's norms will be considered for engagement.
  • Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not assure engagement.
  • Candidature is provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates/testimonials at any stage; false or incorrect information can lead to cancellation of candidature or engagement.

Documents Required for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  • Certificate showing CGPA or percentage, to be uploaded in the "Upload Certificate" column on the NATS portal.
  • If only CGPA is mentioned on the certificate, candidates must also upload the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula/certificate.
  • The Undertaking (Annexure I, provided with the notification), duly filled and signed.
  • The above documents must be uploaded together as a single PDF file of size less than 1 MB.

How to Apply for RailTel Apprentice Recruitment 2026

RailTel Apprentice Apply Online

Eligible candidates must apply online through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) 2.0 portal - no other mode of application will be entertained under any circumstances.

  1. Visit the NATS 2.0 portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Candidates not already registered on the NATS 2.0 portal must register themselves before applying for this position.
  3. Follow the application process as described in the NATS Apprentice student manual, available at the portal.
  4. Fill in the application form and upload the certificate showing CGPA or percentage, along with the CGPA-conversion certificate (if applicable) and the signed Undertaking, as a single PDF under 1 MB.
  5. Submit the application on or before the last date, 27.08.2026.

RailTel Apprentice Important Instructions

  • The numbers and locations of posts shown in the notification are indicative and may change without further notice.
  • Apprentice engagement will be strictly for a period of one year, at locations across the Northern, Western, Eastern and Southern regions, or anywhere on a pan-India basis.
  • The reservation policy as prescribed in the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 will be followed; in case of non-availability of candidates in reserved categories, the position will be filled from other reserved or general categories.
  • Apprentices have no right to claim regular employment from RailTel at any point; the apprenticeship does not create any liability on RailTel for providing a job or placement.
  • The decision of RailTel's management will be final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and the selection process; no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 29 July 2026 on the official website of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). A total of 120 vacancies have been announced through the HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026, including 60 Design Trainee (DT) and 60 Management Trainee (MT) posts across various engineering disciplines.

Candidates aged up to 28 years who have a full-time Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline with the prescribed minimum marks are eligible to apply for these trainee vacancies. The online application process for HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 started on 29 July 2026 (2:00 PM) and will remain open until 14 August 2026 (2:00 PM).

Candidates can download the HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

HAL Design Trainee/ Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has released the official notification for the Selection of Design Trainees/Management Trainees - 2026 through Advertisement No. HAL/CHRC-TM/RECT-02/2026 dated 29-07-2026. The notification includes complete details about discipline-wise vacancies, eligibility, age limit, application fee, selection process, and important dates. Eligible candidates with a Bachelor's Degree in the notified Engineering disciplines can apply online until 14-08-2026. Candidates can use the direct link below to download the official notification PDF and read all recruitment details.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology or its equivalent, acquired on a Regular/Full Time basis from a recognized University/Institution in the country under the 10+2+4 pattern (10+3+3 in case of lateral entry), in the disciplines/eligible branches notified for each post.
  • Candidates possessing an Engineering Degree in any discipline/branch other than those notified are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates possessing Part Time/Correspondence/E-learning/Distance Education courses are not eligible to apply. Only Full Time/Regular Courses will be considered.
  • Candidates possessing a Diploma along with an Engineering Degree in the notified discipline must enter the marks of the Engineering Degree as qualifying marks in the online application.
  • Candidates possessing a 5-year Integrated Degree in the notified discipline/branch of Engineering are also eligible to apply.
  • Candidates currently in the Final Year/Final Semester of their Bachelor's Degree may also apply, subject to having secured the prescribed aggregate percentage up to the last semester/year at the time of applying; selection will be further subject to obtaining the minimum prescribed aggregate in the final degree, with documentary proof required at the time of Interview (tentatively scheduled for September 2026).

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Upper age limit: candidates should not be above 28 years as on 14-08-2026 for UR & EWS category.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS categories applying under UR Category will be treated on par with UR criteria.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs), over and above relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) categories.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for candidates domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir during 01-01-1980 to 31-12-1989.
  • Upper age limit relaxable up to a maximum of 5 years for Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers/Emergency Commissioned Officers/Short Service Commissioned Officers with at least 5 years of Military Service, subject to other prescribed conditions.
  • Age after all applicable relaxations should not exceed 56 years for PwBDs and 55 years for other candidates.

Also Read: NICL Assistant Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 500 Vacancies

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories will be as per prevalent Government directives.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to relaxation under OBC(NCL) category and must indicate their category as UR in the online application.
  • The candidate's caste/community name must appear in the Central List of Other Backward Classes; a Central OBC(NCL) Certificate not older than 6 months as on 14-08-2026 must be furnished at the time of Interview, if called for.
  • Reservation of vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) will be distributed among all categories (SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS & UR). PwBDs with not less than 40% of the identified disability shall be eligible for the benefit of reservation.
  • 3 vacancies are earmarked for PwBDs under Design Trainee (all disciplines), and 2 vacancies under Management Trainee (across Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, and Civil disciplines), covering identified disability categories including Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, and Multiple Disabilities, as detailed in the official notification.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • Application fee: ₹500 (inclusive of GST)
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • HAL will not be responsible if a candidate deposits the fee to the wrong account or makes multiple payments.
  • Mode of payment: Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI through the SBIePAY payment gateway (for UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories only). Applicable convenience fee and taxes, if any, over and above the application fee will be borne by the candidate.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection comprises an Online Computer Based Selection Test (All-India basis) followed by a Personal Interview at Bengaluru.
  • The test will be of 2.5 hours duration, comprising Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts: Part I - 20 MCQs on General Awareness; Part II - 40 MCQs on English & Reasoning; Part III - 100 MCQs on the concerned discipline.
  • The test can be taken in Hindi or English, as per the candidate's choice indicated at the time of applying (cannot be changed later).
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on Online Test marks, in the ratio of 1:5 to the number of vacancies in each discipline and category.
  • The Final Merit List will be prepared with a weightage of 85% for the Online Test and 15% for the Interview.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks each in the Written Test and Interview to qualify for selection (relaxation for reserved categories as per rules).
  • Candidates must produce an original Identity Card (Voter ID/Driving License/Aadhaar/Passport/PAN/Government or PSU-issued ID/College ID) before the Invigilator to appear for the Online Test.

How to Apply for HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  1. Before registering, candidates should have ready: a valid, active e-mail ID; a soft copy passport-size colour photograph (.jpg, under 180 KB); Aadhaar Number and Mobile Number; educational details (semester-wise marks); and employment details (if applicable).
  2. Visit the HAL website www.hal-india.co.in (Careers Section) and click on the link "SELECTION OF DESIGN TRAINEE/MANAGEMENT TRAINEE - 2026," then select the post applied for.
  3. Enter and re-enter a valid e-mail ID for OTP-based registration.
  4. Fill up Eligibility Details and upload the photograph. A unique Application Number will be generated (Eligibility Details cannot be edited once submitted).
  5. Fill up Personal & Qualification Details, with an "Edit" option provided before final submission.
  6. SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates: registration is completed upon submission, and an Application Confirmation page is generated.
  7. UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates: will be directed to the Payment Gateway to pay the application fee of ₹500 (inclusive of GST) via Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  8. After successful payment, candidates will be redirected to the Application Confirmation Page - print and retain this for future reference.
  9. Complete the process well before the last date (14-08-2026, 1400 hrs) to avoid last-minute website traffic issues. Non-payment of fee or incomplete steps will render the application incomplete and it will be rejected.
  10. Note: Applying for more than one post (e.g., MT Mechanical and DT Mechanical) will lead to rejection of candidature, and any application fee paid will be forfeited.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Placement & Emoluments

  • Selected candidates will be posted at any of HAL's Production, Overhaul, or Service Divisions/Research & Design Centres/Offices, based on Company requirements.
  • Training programme duration: 52 weeks, comprising theoretical and On-the-Job training at various locations.
  • During training, Trainees will draw a stipend comprising Basic Pay of ₹50,000, plus Variable Dearness Allowance and Canteen Allowance. Bachelor Accommodation is also admissible during training, as per Company Rules.
  • On successful completion of training, Trainees will be absorbed as Engineers in the Grade-II Scale of Pay of ₹50,000 - ₹1,60,000, with eligibility for Basic Pay, Variable Dearness Allowance, other Perks & Allowances under the Cafeteria system, Company Accommodation/HRA, Performance Related Pay, Medical Facilities, Provident Fund, Gratuity, and other superannuation benefits as per Company Rules.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Service Agreement Bond

  • Selected candidates must execute a Service Agreement Bond to serve HAL for a period of 5 years (excluding the training period).
  • In case of breach of the Service Agreement (during training or after absorption as Engineer), the candidate is liable to reimburse actual training expenses (including recruitment expenses and all remuneration/expenses incurred during training), subject to a maximum of ₹15,00,000 (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs only).

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Pre-Employment Medical Standards

  • Candidates provisionally selected, including PwBDs, must undergo a Pre-employment Medical Examination before joining HAL.
  • Candidates must have sound health and meet the medical standards prescribed by the Company; appointment is subject to a satisfactory medical report. The decision of the Company's Doctor in this regard is final and binding, and no relaxation in health standards will be allowed.
  • For PwBDs, suitability for appointment will be decided based on Reports of the Medical Board attached to the Special Employment Exchanges for Physically Handicapped; their appointment will remain provisional until Disability Certificate verification is completed.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Quasi-Government/Autonomous Bodies (including on contract basis) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of Interview, failing which they will not be permitted to appear and will not be eligible for Travelling Allowance.
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS/UR) once filled in the online application cannot be changed later, and no benefit of another category will be admissible subsequently.
  • Candidates under reserved categories must submit Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate in the prescribed Central Government format at the time of Interview (tentatively scheduled during September 2026 at Bengaluru).
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to verification of Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate and Character & Antecedents from concerned authorities.
  • Internal Candidates of HAL must also apply online and refer to the internal Circular dated 29-07-2026 before filling the application.
  • Mere submission of application does not entail any right to appointment or to appear in different stages of the selection process; HAL's decision in this regard shall be final.
  • There will be no separate communication to candidates regarding non-selection at any stage.
  • HAL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/increase/modify/alter the advertisement or recruitment process, and the number of vacancies notified may be increased/decreased/cancelled at the Company's discretion, without assigning reasons.
  • If information furnished by a candidate is found false, incomplete, suppressed, or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, the candidature/appointment will be revoked/terminated at any stage, without reference to the candidate.
  • Induction Training for DTs/MTs is tentatively scheduled to commence end of October 2026 at Bengaluru.
  • Any canvassing or influencing of officials related to the recruitment/selection process will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Bengaluru. In case of any ambiguity in versions other than English, the English version will prevail.
  • For queries not covered in the notification or FAQs, candidates can write to HAL at [email protected].
  • All recruitment/selection related information will be hosted only on the HAL website www.hal-india.co.in; candidates are advised not to rely on any other website, social media platform, or email/message circulation.
  • Any Corrigendum/Addendum will be issued only on the HAL website.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Vacancy 2026

NABFINS has announced an opportunity for the post of Customer Service Officer. The CSO works closely with the branch team and plays an important role in customer sourcing, portfolio growth, verification, field operations, disbursement support and recovery.

The number of vacancies has not been specified in the details provided for this recruitment.

Post Name Vacancies
Customer Service Officer (CSO) Not Specified

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Job Role

The primary responsibility of a Customer Service Officer is to source customers and increase the sustainable portfolio of the branch.

The CSO has to identify new business locations, source potential customers and support their addition to the branch portfolio. After disbursement, the employee is also responsible for following up with customers and collecting installments on scheduled dates.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of a NABFINS Customer Service Officer include:

  • Sourcing of clients.
  • Primary verification of client credentials.
  • Conducting Compulsory Group Training.
  • Data entry in CRIF.
  • Data entry in CMS.
  • Accompanying the Branch Manager for Group Recognition Test.
  • Accompanying CSE during pre-disbursement activities.
  • Ensuring disbursement.
  • Generating demand.
  • Following up for recovery and undertaking collections.
  • Remitting collections in the bank or banks.
  • Reporting demand and collection details to ABM/BM.
  • Maintaining and filing documents.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates applying for the NABFINS Customer Service Officer Recruitment 2026 must meet the prescribed educational, language and field mobility requirements.

NABFINS Customer Service Officer Qualification

Eligible candidates who have passed PUC or an equivalent qualification can apply online from 11 July 2026 to 07 August 2026.

KEA VAO Notification PDF

Candidates should read the full official notification before applying, as it contains complete details on eligibility, reservation, and exam rules. Two separate notifications have been issued for this recruitment cycle - one for the General/RPC cadre (Notification No. ED/KEA/26/NEV/2026(RPC)) and one for the Kalyana-Karnataka cadre (Notification No. ED/KEA/27/NEV/2026(KK)) - both dated 10 July 2026.

KEA VAO Recruitment 2026 Overview

The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released two separate notifications, dated 10 July 2026, inviting online applications for 572 Village Accountant posts under the Revenue Department. The vacancies are split between 505 posts under the General/RPC cadre across 21 districts and 67 posts reserved for the Kalyana-Karnataka region under Article 371(J). Eligible candidates who have passed PUC or an equivalent qualification can apply online from 11 July 2026 to 07 August 2026.

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
Post Name Village Accountant / Grama Aadalitha Adhikari (Village Administrative Officer)
Total Vacancies 572 (505 General/RPC + 67 Kalyana-Karnataka)
Notification No. (General/RPC) ED/KEA/26/NEV/2026(RPC)
Notification No. (Kalyana-Karnataka) ED/KEA/27/NEV/2026(KK)
Notification Date 10 July 2026
Mode of Application Online only
Selection Process Competitive written examination (Offline-OMR mode)
Pay Scale ₹34,100 - ₹67,600
Probation Period 2 years
Official Website cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea

KEA VAO Important Dates 2026

Candidates must complete the entire application process, including fee payment, within the schedule given below. No changes are permitted after submission, so applicants should keep these dates in mind.

Exam Timing - Paper 2 2:30 PM to 4:30 PM
Admit Card / Exam Centre Details Not Announced Yet

KEA VAO Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must satisfy both the nationality and educational qualification requirements laid down in the notification before applying.

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • A living man having more than one wife, and a woman who has married such a man, are not eligible for appointment without prior Government permission.
  • Candidates must be mentally and physically fit to discharge the duties of the post.

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for the post of Village Accountant must have passed PUC (Pre-University Course, equivalent to Class 12) or a qualification recognized as equivalent to PUC by the Government of Karnataka. Equivalent qualifications include:

  • Class 12 examination conducted by CBSE or ICSE boards.
  • Class 12 examination conducted by other State Government pre-university education boards.
  • Advanced vocational courses/NSDC-affiliated courses conducted through the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS).
  • Candidates with a two-year ITI (Industrial Training Institute) course, provided they have also passed one language subject and one general subject at a pre-degree level examination, are treated as equivalent to PUC only for these specified fields.
  • Candidates who completed a three-year diploma from a technical education department institution before 2015 are also required to have cleared the Kannada-language subject through an SSLC-level examination.

Candidates possessing a qualification higher than PUC are also eligible to apply, provided they meet the other eligibility conditions.

KEA VAO Age Limit 2026

The minimum age required is 18 years as on the closing date of application, as per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977. The upper age limit for direct recruitment, inclusive of the 5-year relaxation granted vide Government Order dated 29 January 2026, is given below.

Category Upper Age Limit (Direct Recruitment)
General / Unreserved 40 years
Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B 43 years
SC / ST / Category-1 45 years

Age Relaxation

Additional age relaxation beyond the above limits is permitted for specific categories, as detailed in the notification, including:

  • Persons already serving in Karnataka Government, local body, State/Central statutory or PSU service - relaxation equal to years of service or 10 years, whichever is less.
  • Ex-servicemen - relaxation equal to the length of service rendered, plus 3 years.
  • National Cadet Corps (NCC) full-time supervisors - relaxation equal to years of service.
  • Persons employed as Grama Samuha Parishilakaru under the rural self-employment scheme - relaxation equal to years of service.
  • Special Chetana (persons with disabilities) candidates - 10 years relaxation.
  • Persons employed by the Government of India census organization in Karnataka - relaxation equal to years of service or 5 years, whichever is less.
  • Widows who have not remarried, or women legally divorced and not remarried - 10 years relaxation, subject to proof.
  • Retrenched employees who repaid retrenchment compensation as per the Karnataka Retrenched Employees Act/1957 rules - 10 years relaxation, subject to proof.
  • Transgender/third-gender candidates - 1% horizontal reservation with corresponding age relaxation as per the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019.

Candidates seeking any of the above relaxations must produce the original supporting certificate at the time of document verification.

KEA VAO Salary 2026

Selected candidates for the post of Village Accountant will be placed on the state government pay scale below and will be entitled to benefits under the National Pension Scheme (NPS). All appointees will serve a probation period of 2 years from the date of regular appointment.

  • Pay Scale: ₹34,100 - 800 - 35,700 - 900 - 39,300 - 1,000 - 43,300 - 1,125 - 47,800 - 1,250 - 52,800 - 1,375 - 58,300 - 1,500 - 64,300 - 1,650 - 67,600

KEA VAO Application Fee 2026

The application fee must be paid online only, at the time of form submission. Fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

Category Application Fee
General and Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B ₹750 (₹500 application fee + ₹250 processing fee)
SC / ST / Category-1 / Ex-Servicemen / Third Gender ₹500 (₹250 application fee + ₹250 processing fee)
Special Chetana (PwBD) candidates ₹250 (processing fee only)

KEA VAO Selection Process 2026

Selection to the post of Village Accountant is made purely through a competitive written examination; the notification does not mention any separate interview round. The process is as follows:

  • Candidates will appear for a competitive written examination conducted in Offline-OMR mode.
  • A minimum of 35% marks in the competitive exam is required for eligibility; candidates scoring below this will be disqualified.
  • Candidates opting for the Kannada language exam exemption must have passed Kannada as first or second language up to SSLC level, or must clear a compulsory qualifying Kannada language test (150 marks, minimum 50 marks required to qualify). This paper is not counted toward merit ranking.
  • District-wise merit lists / marks lists will be prepared and forwarded by KEA to the respective District Magistrates for appointment, which is made at the district level.

KEA VAO Exam Pattern 2026

The written examination consists of two papers, each carrying 100 marks and lasting 2 hours, with negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer.

Paper Subject Total Questions Total Marks Duration
Paper 1 General Knowledge (current affairs, general science, Indian Constitution, Indian and Karnataka history and geography, Panchayat Raj and rural cooperative institutions, and Karnataka regional issues and development) 100 100 2 hours
Paper 2 General Kannada, General English, and Computer Knowledge 100 100 2 hours

Each question offers 4 answer options with only one correct answer. A minimum qualifying score of 35% is required in the competitive exam.

How to Apply for KEA VAO Recruitment 2026

Applicants must apply strictly online through the KEA CET portal by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official KEA website: cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea
  2. Click on the application link for VAO Recruitment 2026 applicable to your cadre (General/RPC or Kalyana-Karnataka).
  3. Register with your basic details and generate login credentials.
  4. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details, selecting only one district of preference.
  5. Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPEG format, 50KB-200KB) and signature (JPEG format, 50KB-70KB) as per the specified format.
  6. Verify all entered details carefully, as no correction is allowed after submission.
  7. Pay the applicable application fee online and complete the submission.
  8. Download and retain a printout of the submitted application and fee payment receipt for future reference.

KEA VAO Important Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted online only; offline or postal applications will not be considered.
  • Candidates can apply to only one district; applications submitted for more than one district will not be accepted.
  • Original documents must be produced at the time of document verification for eligibility, age, and category claims. Failure to appear with valid original documents on the specified date will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Candidates are responsible for reading all eligibility instructions before applying; incomplete or incorrect information may result in rejection of candidature at any stage.
  • Impersonation, submission of forged documents, or use of unfair means during the exam or interview process will lead to disqualification and possible criminal/disciplinary action.
  • Aadhaar Card is mandatory for application submission.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols

  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Forest Department Jobs Salary Overview

Post Pay Level / Pay Scale Approximate Gross Salary (Monthly)
Forest Guard / Field Guard Pay Level 3 ₹28,000 – ₹35,000
Forester Pay Level 4–5 ₹35,000 – ₹45,000
Range Forest Officer Pay Level 7–8 ₹50,000 – ₹65,000
Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) Pay Level 10 ₹70,000 – ₹95,000
Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer Pay Level 10 and above ₹80,000+ (with allowances)

Figures are indicative and vary by state pay commission; always confirm exact pay scale from the official notification.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

How to Apply for Forest Department Recruitment 2026 (Apply Online)

Follow these steps to complete your forest department recruitment 2026 apply online process:

  1. Visit the official website of the respective state Forest Department or recruitment board (link provided in the notification table above)
  2. Register using your mobile number and email ID to generate login credentials
  3. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details
  4. Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and required certificates
  5. Pay the application fee online via net banking, debit card, or UPI (fee varies by category and state)
  6. Review all entered details carefully before final submission
  7. Submit the form and download/print the confirmation page for future reference

Documents Required & Application Fee

Documents required:

  • Passport-size photograph and signature (scanned, as per specified format)
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Date of birth proof (10th certificate or birth certificate)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), if applicable
  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applying under that quota
  • Domicile/residence certificate, where required by the state

Application fee: Typically ranges from ₹200–₹1,000 depending on the state and category, with fee concessions or exemptions commonly available for SC/ST, PwBD, and ex-servicemen candidates.
