FAQs - Forest Department Recruitment 2026

Q1: What is the latest forest department recruitment 2026?

The latest notifications include Forest Guard, Forester, Range Forest Officer, and Group C forest posts released by state forest departments, PSCs, and staff selection boards. Check the table above for live vacancies and last dates, updated daily.

Q2: What is the last date to apply for forest department recruitment 2026?

The application last date varies by state and recruiting body - it is listed against each notification in the table above under "Last Date to Apply." Always confirm the exact date on the official notification before applying.

Q3: What is the qualification for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Most Forest Guard and Field Guard posts require a 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board. Higher posts like Forester or Range Forest Officer typically need 12th pass, a graduate degree, or a degree in a science/forestry-related field.

Q4: Is there any age relaxation for ex-servicemen in forest department recruitment?

Yes. Jobs for ex-servicemen in the forest department usually come with reserved vacancies and additional age relaxation - typically 3 to 5 years beyond the standard age limit - along with relaxed physical standards in many states.

Q5: How can I apply online for forest department vacancy 2026?

Visit the official website of the respective state forest department or recruitment board, register with your basic details, fill in the application form, upload the required documents, pay the fee, and submit. Full step-by-step details are in the "How to Apply" section above.

Q6: Which states have active forest guard recruitment 2026 notifications?

States including West Bengal, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Himachal Pradesh, and Tripura currently have or regularly release forest guard and forest officer vacancies. See the state-wise section above for details on each.

Q7: What is the salary for forest guard and forest officer posts in 2026?

Forest Guard salary typically ranges from ₹28,000 to ₹35,000 gross per month under Pay Level 3, while Range Forest Officer and ACF posts range from ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 depending on pay level. Full breakdown is in the salary table above.

Q8: Is there a written exam for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Yes, most states conduct a written exam covering General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, and Mathematics, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and document verification before the final merit list is prepared.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following essential qualification and registration requirements to appear in NORCET-11. Eligibility must be fulfilled on or before the closing date of online registration, i.e. 13 August 2026.

AIIMS Nursing Officer Educational Qualification

Candidates must meet either of the following two eligibility routes:

  • Route I: B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing from an Indian Nursing Council or State Nursing Council recognized institute or university, OR Post-Certificate/Post-Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized institute/university; AND registration as a Nurse and Midwife with the State or Indian Nursing Council.
  • Route II: Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) from a recognized institute/board/council; registration as a Nurse and Midwife with the State or Indian Nursing Council; and two years of experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital acquired after obtaining the essential qualification (i.e., after completing residency, declaration of result, and council registration).

Candidates who have completed their nursing qualification can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and GNM/Staff Nurse Jobs available across India.

The base age limit for all AIIMS is 18 to 30 years. The crucial date for determining age is the closing date of online registration, i.e. 13 August 2026.

AIIMS NORCET 11 2026 Salary Structure

Selected Nursing Officers will be placed at Level 07 in the Pay Matrix, corresponding to the pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs. 9,300–34,800 with Grade Pay of Rs. 4,600/-, under Group-B classification. Posts also carry usual allowances admissible to Central Government servants of similar status, as applicable at the respective posting city.

AIIMS NORCET 11 Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee
General / OBC Rs. 3000/-
SC / ST / EWS Rs. 2400/-
Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) Exempted

Fees can be paid online through Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking. Any transaction/processing fee applicable will be borne by the candidate. The application fee, once remitted, is non-refundable under any circumstances, except that SC/ST candidates who appear in the examination will have their fee refunded after declaration of results and verification of certificates.

AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is made through a two-stage Computer-Based Test (CBT):

  • Stage I – NORCET Preliminary: A 90-minute qualifying exam with 100 MCQs (100 marks) - 20 questions on General Knowledge & Aptitude and 80 on Nursing subjects. There is negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer. This stage only qualifies candidates for Stage II and is not used for final merit.
  • Stage II – NORCET Mains: A 180-minute exam with 160 case-scenario-based MCQs (160 marks) covering the nursing syllabus, testing clinical skill competency. Negative marking of 1/3 mark per wrong answer applies. Final merit is based solely on Stage II performance.

Qualifying marks for Stage I are 50 percentile (UR/EWS), 45 percentile (OBC), and 40 percentile (SC/ST), with a further 5 percentile relaxation for PWBD candidates. Qualifying marks for Stage II are 50% (UR/EWS), 45% (OBC), and 40% (SC/ST), with a similar 5% PWBD relaxation. Candidates qualifying in Stage I, up to 5 times the seats per category, are called for Stage II. Ties in Stage II merit are resolved sequentially by fewer negative marks in Stage II, higher Stage I score, fewer negative marks in Stage I, older date of birth, and finally alphabetical order of name.

AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

  • Downloaded copy of the online application Registration Slip
  • Downloaded copy of the Admit Card
  • Certificate showing Date of Birth
  • Caste Certificate / Income & Asset (EWS) Certificate, if applicable, issued by competent authority
  • Disability Certificate, if applying under PWBD category
  • Certificate for age relaxation claimed on grounds other than caste/PWBD, where applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), if currently employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous body
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Indian Nursing Council / State Nursing Council registration certificate
  • Experience certificate, if applicable (mentioning bed strength, duration, and nature of duties)
  • Any other certificate as required by the respective AIIMS/Institute

How to Apply Online for AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official AIIMS Examination website: www.aiimsexams.ac.in
  2. Locate and click on the NORCET-11 online registration link.
  3. Register with basic details, or log in using your existing One Time Registration (OTR) ID if previously registered.
  4. Fill in the online application form carefully with personal, educational, and category details.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, and thumb impression as per the prescribed image guidelines.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee online via Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking.
  7. Review all entered details in the preview screen, as corrections are not permitted after submission.
  8. Submit the application and download/save a copy of the confirmation and fee payment proof for future reference.

AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates already registered under OTR or a previous examination must apply using the same old ID/OTR registration; applying with a different ID will lead to rejection.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies must upload a valid NOC by 18 August 2026 (5:00 PM); failure will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No correction is permitted after the specified dates, including changes to category (SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS) once the registration fee is submitted.
  • No extension of dates will be provided under any circumstances.
  • Any change of allotted examination centre will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates should rely only on official notices published on www.aiimsexams.ac.in; AIIMS does not authorize any agent, coaching centre, or third-party website for recruitment-related activities.
  • The OBC-NCL certificate must be valid for financial year 2026–2027 and issued between 01.04.2026 and 13.08.2026.
  • The EWS certificate must be based on financial year 2025-2026 income and issued between 01.04.2026 and 13.08.2026.
  • Candidature remains provisional until final document verification; ineligibility detected at any stage, including after joining, will lead to cancellation.

Qualification: Master’s Degree in the respective discipline from a recognized university, with 3 years’ research experience after acquiring the essential qualification. PhD and lab experience in conservation/non-destructive testing are desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC).

8. Civilian Medical Officer

Qualification: Recognized MBBS degree with completion of compulsory rotating internship. Post-graduate medical qualification is desirable. Age limit: 35 years (UR/EWS), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC/ST).

9. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion)

Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma (MD/DNB) in Immunology, Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion, Pathology, Bacteriology or Haematology with relevant special training, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Registrar/Assistant Professor. Age limit: 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC).

10. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Surgical Oncology)

Qualification: MBBS with a postgraduate degree/diploma in Surgical Oncology or General Surgery/ENT/Orthopaedics/Obst. & Gynae with special training in Surgical Oncology, plus at least 3 years’ teaching experience. Age limit: 43 years (OBC).

11. Assistant Industrial Adviser

Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Chemical/Metallurgical/Electronics & Communication Engineering, with 3 years’ experience in steel works/rolling mills/plant machinery manufacturing or in iron & steel production, planning, development and research. Age limit: 35 years (UR).

12. Veterinary Assistant Surgeon

Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Science, registered with the Veterinary Council of India or a State/UT Veterinary Council. Knowledge of Tamil, Malayalam or Telugu is an advantage. Age limit: 35 years (UR), 38 years (OBC), 40 years (SC).

Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) to shortlist candidates for interview, followed by a Personality Test/Interview. Key details:

  • CRT will be held on 01 November 2026 at 15 designated centres.
  • The test is of 2 hours' duration, objective type (MCQs), available in English and Hindi, carrying a maximum of 300 marks.
  • There is negative marking: one-third of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Weightage of CRT and Interview marks is 75:25 for determining final merit.
  • Minimum suitability standard in interview: General/EWS – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 marks (out of 100).

CRT Syllabus

  • General Knowledge including contemporary social, economic and cultural issues
  • Hindi and English language skills
  • Reasoning ability and Quantitative Aptitude
  • Educational policies & educational measurement and evaluation
  • Management and Financial administration
  • Office Procedure
  • Pedagogy in Education
  • Digital Literacy

How to Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 (up to 1800 Hrs) through https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/. The process involves four modules:

  1. Account creation
  2. Universal Registration (generates a Universal Registration Number – URN)
  3. Common Application Form (CAF)
  4. Post/Vacancy-specific module (to be filled within the notified time period)

Candidates must upload a photograph, capture a live photo, and upload their signature (signed thrice on plain white paper) as part of the CAF. Applications, once submitted, cannot be withdrawn or edited. Candidates are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card for ID verification and to apply well in advance of the closing date.

Documents Required

  • Matriculation/10th certificate or equivalent (proof of date of birth)
  • Degree/Diploma certificate (Master's Degree, B.Ed)
  • Experience certificate(s) in prescribed proforma from Head(s) of Organisation/Department
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates) in prescribed proforma
  • OBC non-creamy layer declaration (for OBC candidates)
  • Certificate of Disability in prescribed proforma (for PwBD candidates)
  • Documents for change of name, if applicable
  • Age relaxation certificates (Ex-Servicemen, Government employees, PwBD, etc.), if applicable

Note: Documents like Pay Slip, Resume, Appointment Letter, Relieving Letter, or unsigned Experience Certificates must NOT be uploaded.

Important Instructions

  • Reservation under OBC category applies only to candidates with OBC certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi; certificates from other States/UTs will be treated as General/Unreserved.
  • The closing date for submission of the online application is the date for determining eligibility in every respect.
  • Candidates already in regular Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department of their application.
  • Candidates must provide a valid, active email ID, as all correspondence will be made through email only.
  • No printouts or documents are to be sent to the Commission by post; they must be brought to the interview if shortlisted.
  • Mobile phones and other electronic/communication devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts may lead to rejection, debarment, and disciplinary/criminal action.

  • Master's degree from a recognized University in English with Hindi as a compulsory or elective subject, or as the medium of examination at degree level; OR
  • Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi as medium and English as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR
  • Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with English as medium and Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level; OR
  • Master's degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or either as medium of examination and the other as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level.

AND, in addition to the above, candidates must also possess:

  • A recognized Diploma or Certificate Course in translation from Hindi to English and vice-versa, OR
  • Two years' experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice-versa in a Central Government or State Government office, including a Government of India Undertaking.

STPI Junior Hindi Translator Age Limit 2026

The maximum age limit for appointment on direct recruitment basis is 30 years. Age is reckoned as on the last date of receipt of online applications, i.e., 07.09.2026.

Category Age Relaxation
Government Servants Up to 5 years, as per Central Government instructions/orders
SC/ST/OBC/PwD and other categories As per prevailing Government of India instructions (relaxable as applicable)

STPI Junior Hindi Translator 2026 Salary Structure

The post of Junior Hindi Translator carries Pay Matrix Level 6 (Rs. 35,400 - 112,400) as per the 7th Central Pay Commission. The appointment will initially be on probation for a period of two years, which may be regularized, extended, or terminated based on performance during the probation period.

STPI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General/UR/OBC (Male candidates) Rs. 500/-
Female candidates No fee
SC/ST/PH candidates No fee

The mode and process of fee payment will be specified on the online application portal. Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the JHT post will be based on a written examination consisting of two papers:

Part Mode Subject Marks/Questions Duration
Paper-I Objective Type Part-I: General Hindi; Part-II: General English 100 + 100 = 200 2 hours (1 hr sectional timer each part); 2 hrs 40 mins for scribe-eligible candidates
Paper-II Descriptive Translation & Essay 200 2 hours; 2 hrs 40 mins for scribe-eligible candidates
  • Paper-I consists of objective-type multiple-choice questions testing understanding of Hindi and English language and literature, correct usage of words, phrases, and idioms.
  • There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.
  • Based on marks scored in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise for Paper-II.
  • Paper-II includes one passage for translation from Hindi to English, one passage from English to Hindi, and an essay each in Hindi and English.

Minimum Qualifying Marks in Paper-I

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
UR/General 50%
OBC 45%
SC 40%

Final Merit / Weightage

For final selection, weightage will be 50% of the scores in Paper-I and 100% of the marks in Paper-II. There may be separate category-wise cut-offs for Paper-I and Paper-II. Minimum marks required for final selection/merit are as follows:

S. No. Category Minimum Marks for Final Selection/Merit
1 General Category 50%
2 OBC Category 45%
3 SC Category 40%

In case of a tie in aggregate marks, resolution will follow this order: (1) marks in Paper-II, (2) date of birth (older candidates placed higher), (3) alphabetical order of candidates' names.

STPI Recruitment 2026 Examination Centres

The examination for the Junior Hindi Translator post will be conducted at Delhi/NCR and Bengaluru locations.

STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

  • Educational qualification certificates (Master's degree marksheet/certificate)
  • Translation Diploma/Certificate Course certificate, or experience certificate (2 years' translation work in Central/State Government office or PSU), if applicable
  • Date of Birth proof (as per Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC) in the prescribed Central Government format, where applicable
  • NOC (No Objection Certificate) from current employer, for candidates working in Central/State Government/PSUs/Autonomous organizations
  • OBC candidates must additionally submit a non-creamy-layer certificate in the prescribed format

How to Apply Online for STPI Junior Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official STPI website: www.stpi.in
  2. Locate the online application link for Employment Notice No. 2(1)/I/STPI-HQ/2026-27.
  3. Register and fill in the online application form carefully, ensuring all essential steps are completed.
  4. Upload the required scanned documents and category/qualification certificates as applicable.
  5. Pay the applicable application fee (if not exempted) through the mode specified on the portal.
  6. Submit the application before the last date, i.e., 07.09.2026 (23:00 hours).
  7. Save/download the confirmation page for future reference.

Note: No other mode of application (offline/postal/email) shall be accepted. Only completed and fully filled online applications will be considered for further recruitment processing.

Important Instructions - STPI Recruitment 2026

  • Candidates working in Central/State Government/PSUs/Autonomous organizations may submit a copy of NOC issued from their organization at the time of applying online.
  • The number of posts may vary; STPI reserves the right not to fill any of the notified posts.
  • Candidates must not furnish false, misleading, or fabricated information/documents. Any such case detected at any stage may lead to cancellation of candidature or termination of service, even after appointment.
  • No correspondence will be entertained regarding the selection/test/interview/appointment process. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates seeking reservation or age relaxation must submit the requisite certificates in the prescribed Central Government format; certificates in any other format are liable to be rejected.
  • Candidature will remain provisional until verification of educational, caste/category, and other certificates by the Appointing Authority.
  • Selected candidates shall be liable to be posted at any centre of STPI (STPI currently has 73 centres across India).
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for the written test.
  • Any litigation arising from this recruitment will be subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

NF Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must be citizens of India and satisfy the educational qualification, age limit and minimum sports achievement norms prescribed for the pay level and event they are applying for.

Educational Qualification

Pay Level Minimum Educational Qualification
Level 3 or 2 Passed Class 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent from a Government-recognized Board/Council/Institution
Level 1 Passed Class 10th (Matriculation) or ITI or equivalent, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT

For Technician-III posts filled against Sports Quota, the minimum qualification is Class 10th pass; the training period is 3 years unless the candidate holds a relevant ITI qualification, in which case it is reduced to 6 months.

Age Limit

Candidates for both Level 3/2 and Level 1 posts must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on 01 January 2027. The notification does not specify age relaxation details for reserved categories; candidates should refer to the official notification or website for any updates on this.

Minimum Sports Norms

Candidates must be active players whose achievements fall within the immediately preceding two financial years, and only achievements in recognized events held on or after 01 April 2024 will be considered.

Pay Level Minimum Sports Norms
Level 3/2 Represented the country in Category-B events, OR 3rd position or better in Category-C events/Senior-Youth-Junior National Championships/National Games/All India Inter University Championships, OR 1st position in Federation Cup (Senior)
Level 1 Represented the country in Category-C events, OR 3rd position or better in Federation Cup (Senior), OR represented a state with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships (except marathon/cross-country)

Sport-specific norms (Archery, Athletics, Badminton/Table Tennis rankings, Basketball, Boxing, Cricket, Football, Golf rankings, Power Lifting, Volleyball and Weightlifting weight categories) are laid out in detail in the official notification. Candidates should check the exact criteria applicable to their event before applying.

NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Salary

The notification specifies posts under Level-1, Level-2 and Level-3 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (corresponding to erstwhile Grade Pay Rs. 1800, 1900 and 2000). The exact in-hand monthly salary figures are not mentioned in the official notification; candidates can refer to the applicable Railway Pay Matrix for these levels for detailed pay information.

NF Railway Sports Quota Application Fee 2026

Category Application Fee
General/Others Rs. 500/-
SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Women, Minority and Economically Backward Class (EBC) Rs. 250/-

Candidates who appear for the selection trial are entitled to a partial refund of the application fee (after deduction of banking and other charges); bank details must be furnished in the online application to receive the refund.

Minority (for fee exemption purposes) includes Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis) and Jains. EBC means candidates whose total family income is less than Rs. 50,000/- per annum.

GSSSB-style Reservation Note

There is no caste-based reservation in this recruitment. However, SC, ST and OBC-NCL candidates must still submit prescribed caste certificates (Annexure-C and Annexure-D) and EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate (Annexure-E) for record purposes, where applicable.

NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is based on a 100-mark merit list comprising a Sports Trial and an Interview.

Stage Marks
Trial (game skill, physical fitness, coach's observations) 40 Marks
Interview - Sports Achievement Assessment 50 Marks
Interview - Educational Qualification 10 Marks
Total 100 Marks
  • Candidates scoring 25 or more out of 40 in the Trial are declared "FIT" and proceed to the Interview stage; those below 25 are declared "NOT FIT" and are not assessed further.
  • Interviews are normally held on the same day as the trial, or the next day at the latest.
  • For educational qualification, 6 marks are given for meeting the minimum qualification; higher qualifications attract higher marks.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 65 for Level-3 and Level-2 posts, and 60 for Level-1 posts.
  • In case of a tie in marks, preference is given to the younger candidate.

NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

  • Scanned copy of educational qualification mark sheet/pass certificate
  • Certificate proving recognized sports achievement held on or after 01 April 2024
  • Proof of date of birth
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates (as per Annexure-C/D), where applicable
  • Income certificate for EBC candidates claiming fee exemption (Annexure-B)
  • Self-declaration for Minority Community candidates claiming fee exemption (Annexure-A)
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates already employed in government/PSU/bank service
  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (3.5cm x 4.5cm, 30-70 KB, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI)
  • Scanned signature (3.5cm x 2.5cm, 20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI)

Candidates must also carry all original documents, the call letter and 4 additional passport-size photographs at the time of trial and document verification.

How to Apply Online for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?

  1. Visit the official Northeast Frontier Railway website: www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in
  2. Navigate to the "Recruitment against Sports Quota" section and locate Notification No. 04/2026.
  3. Register with a valid, active mobile number and email ID, as all communication will be sent through these channels.
  4. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and sports achievement details.
  5. Upload the required documents, photograph and signature as per the specified size and format.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee online.
  7. Review all entered details carefully and submit the application before 24 August 2026.
  8. Save a copy/printout of the submitted application for future reference. Do not send the printout by post.

NF Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only online applications are accepted; applications or certificates sent by post will not be considered.
  • Candidates will be considered only for the specific event/position/game for which they have the recognized sports norms.
  • Candidates having achievement norms for a higher grade pay post are also eligible for lower grade pay posts of the same or a related event.
  • No TA/DA/accommodation is provided for appearing in trials; candidates must bring their own kit and arrange their own stay for 2-3 days if required.
  • Selected candidates must undergo a probation period of two years and sign a Service Bond to serve at least 5 years in Indian Railways.
  • Selected candidates must qualify the prescribed medical examination for the post.
  • Candidates already employed in government service, PSUs or recognized banks must submit a No Objection Certificate.
  • NF Railway has not appointed any agent or coaching centre; candidates should beware of touts and job racketeers.
  • Applications not fulfilling any of the notified terms and conditions are liable to be summarily rejected.
  • Any legal dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal, Guwahati.

Candidates who are Class 12th pass can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and Railway Recruitment 2026 opportunities. Those interested in similar openings can check Sports Quota Recruitment notifications from other Railway zones. Candidates based in the Northeast can also browse more Assam Government Jobs and Guwahati Government Jobs matching their profile.

Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by the Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) on its official website for the recruitment of 5 Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, and Purchase & Stores Officer posts under Advertisement No. 01/2026. This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for experienced professionals looking for prestigious full-time government jobs.

Candidates who possess the prescribed educational qualifications and relevant supervisory experience as specified for each post are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process for PRL Recruitment 2026 has started and will remain open until 24 August 2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), Ahmedabad has officially released Advertisement No. 01/2026 dated 25.07.2026 for the recruitment of 5 Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, and Purchase & Stores Officer posts. The notification provides complete details regarding post-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limit, pay level, application fee, selection process, written test pattern and syllabus, required documents, important instructions, and the online application procedure. Eligible candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their online application. The notification is available on the official PRL website.

  • Notification PDF - Download PRL Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF
  • Apply Online - PRL Recruitment 2026
  • Official Website - PRL Recruitment 2026 Website

PRL Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Organisation Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), Navrangpura, Ahmedabad - 380009
Advertisement No. 01/2026 dated 25.07.2026
Posts Administrative Officer, Accounts Officer, Purchase & Stores Officer
Total Vacancies 5
Pay Level Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500), 7th CPC Pay Matrix
Mode of Selection Written Test + Interview
Mode of Application Online only
Official Website prl.res.in/prl-eng/job_vacancies

PRL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Opening date for online registration 25.07.2026
Closing date for online registration 24.08.2026
Last date for payment of application fee 24.08.2026

The date of the written test and issue of call letters/hall tickets will be notified separately on the PRL website. This information is not available in the current notification.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

A candidate can apply for only one post among the three listed below. The category-wise vacancy and reservation breakup is as follows:

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Administrative Officer 1 (UR-1)
2 Accounts Officer 2 (EWS-1, OBC-1)
3 Purchase & Stores Officer 2 (UR-1, SC-1)

Note: UR = Unreserved, EWS = Economically Weaker Section, OBC (NCL) = Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer), SC = Scheduled Caste. The number of vacancies is provisional and PRL reserves the right to modify vacancies at any stage before the date of examination.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification and Experience

Post Qualification & Experience
Administrative Officer MBA (in HR) with 1 year supervisory experience, OR Post Graduate with 3 years' experience (1 year supervisory), OR Graduate with 5 years' experience (2 years supervisory). Experience must be in Administration.
Accounts Officer ACA/FCA or AICWA/FICWA or MBA (in Finance/Banking Public Systems Management) with 1 year supervisory experience, OR M.Com with 3 years' experience (1 year supervisory), OR B.Com/BBA/BBM with 5 years' experience (2 years supervisory). Experience must be in Finance and Accounts/Cost Accounting.
Purchase & Stores Officer MBA (in Marketing or Materials Management) with 1 year supervisory experience, OR Graduate + PG Diploma in Materials Management (or related subject) with 3 years' experience (1 year supervisory), OR Post Graduate with 3 years' experience (1 year supervisory), OR Graduate with 5 years' experience (2 years supervisory). Experience must be in Purchase & Stores.

Key eligibility notes:

  • Graduation/Post-Graduation (other than MBA/ACA/FCA/FICWA/AICWA/PG Diploma in Materials Management) must be First Class with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.3 on a 10-point scale.
  • Only candidates with MBA in the specific stream mentioned for each post (HR for Administrative Officer, Finance/Banking Public Systems Management for Accounts Officer, Marketing/Materials Management for Purchase & Stores Officer) are eligible to apply.
  • Experience must be obtained only after acquiring the essential educational qualification, and must be in the relevant field (Administration / Accounts & Finance / Purchase & Stores) in a government office, public body, or a reputed commercial organisation.
  • Wherever supervisory experience is required, it must be at least at Level 6 (₹35,400-₹1,12,400) of the Pay Matrix or equivalent (E1 grade in IDA scale for PSU employees, or basic pay of at least ₹35,400 for those in a reputed commercial organisation).
  • Candidates should possess good communication skills, leadership qualities, and familiarity with computers.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The upper age limit is 35 years as on 24.08.2026. Age relaxation is applicable as follows:

  • OBC candidates: up to 38 years (wherever posts are reserved)
  • SC candidates: up to 40 years (wherever posts are reserved)
  • Serving government employees, Ex-Servicemen, and Persons with Disabilities are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India orders.

Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

  • Only persons suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for age relaxation.
  • Candidates availing age relaxation must submit a Disability Certificate in the prescribed format at the time of interview, issued by a Medical Board of at least three members (one being a specialist in the relevant field), duly constituted by the Central or State Government.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Salary and Allowances

Selected candidates will be appointed as Officers in Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with a minimum basic pay of ₹56,100 per month. In addition, the following are payable/admissible as per extant rules:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Transport Allowance
  • National Pension System (NPS) coverage
  • Contributory Health Service Scheme for self and dependent family members
  • Canteen facility
  • Limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA)
  • Departmental transport facility (in lieu of transport allowance)
  • Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
  • Group Insurance

PRL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • The application fee is ₹250 for all posts.
  • Initially, all applicants - including those from fee-exempt categories (Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) - must uniformly pay ₹750 as application fee.
  • Candidates from fee-exemption categories (Women/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) will get a full refund of the application fee if they attend the written test.
  • UR/EWS/OBC candidates will get a refund of ₹500 if they attend the written test.
  • The application fee will not be refunded to candidates who fail to attend the written test.
  • Correct bank account details with IFSC code must be furnished while filling the online application in order to receive the refund.
  • All fee-exempted categories except women must upload the relevant certificate (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) to get the refund.
  • Payment can be made online via Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, either immediately after submission or any day before 24.08.2026.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is through a Written Test followed by an Interview.

  • The written test will be conducted only at Ahmedabad (PRL reserves the right to change the venue).
  • To qualify the written test, candidates must secure at least 40% marks in each part of the objective-type test and a minimum aggregate of 50% in the objective test, plus a minimum of 50% marks in the descriptive-type test.
  • Part D (descriptive) will be evaluated manually only for candidates who have qualified in the other three parts.
  • Based on written test performance, candidates will be shortlisted for interview in a ratio of 1:5 (minimum 10 candidates) against the category-wise number of vacancies. Qualifying the written test alone does not guarantee an interview call.
  • Weightage: Written test - 60%, Interview - 40%.
  • Final empanelment: candidates must secure a minimum of 50% marks each in the written test and interview, with an overall aggregate of at least 60%, considered in order of merit.
  • The written test is of 2 hours 30 minutes duration. PwBD candidates eligible for a scribe/reader get 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour of examination.
  • PwBD candidates must arrange their own scribe/reader (qualification one step below the minimum required for the post) and submit the required declarations (Appendix II and Appendix III) at least 7 days before the exam date. PRL does not provide a scribe/reader.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Written Test Syllabus (Appendix-IV)

Part Type Coverage Questions Marking
Part A Objective (MCQ) General Studies, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part B Objective (MCQ) English Grammar (Graduation level) 32 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part C Objective (MCQ) Post-specific specialised subject (see below) 36 +3 for correct, -1 for wrong
Part D Descriptive Precis writing, Essay writing, Comprehension, Letter writing 2 10 marks per question

Part C specialised subjects by post:

  • Administrative Officer: Constitution of India (including reservations in government service), Industrial Disputes Act, Workmen's Compensation Act, Contract Labour Regulation Act, Apprentices Act, Right to Information Act, Minimum Wages Act, and basic HR management principles (organisation behaviour, motivation, leadership, training and development).
  • Accounts Officer: Principles of Auditing, Costing, Balance Sheet reading, Ratio analysis, Auditing, Management Accountancy, Mercantile Law, Banking Practices, Taxation, and Basics of Economics.
  • Purchase & Stores Officer: Material Management, Import and Export Policy and Procedures, Duties and Taxes (Central and State), Inventory Management, Contract Act, Sale of Goods Act, E-procurement, Capital Budgeting and relevant Mercantile Acts.

PRL Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

Before starting the online application, candidates should keep the following ready:

  • Valid email ID and mobile number
  • Documentary proof of date of birth (Matriculation/10th/SSLC certificate)
  • Scanned copy of final/provisional certificate and marksheet for Graduation/Post Graduation/MBA/PG Diploma/Conversion Certificate, as applicable
  • Scanned copy of caste certificate, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format)
  • Scanned copy of PwBD certificate, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format)
  • Scanned copy of discharge certificate for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable (100 KB, PDF format)
  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (100 KB, JPEG/JPG, not older than 3 months): no selfies, full face frontal view visible, plain/white background, not black-and-white, height and width should be equal
  • Scanned signature (100 KB, JPEG/JPG) with an aspect ratio of 7:2

How to Apply for PRL Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official PRL website: https://www.prl.res.in/prl-eng/job_vacancies
  2. Register online between 25.07.2026 and 24.08.2026, selecting only one post (Administrative Officer OR Accounts Officer OR Purchase & Stores Officer).
  3. Fill in a valid email ID; all future correspondence regarding the written test, interview, etc. will be through email and the website only.
  4. Upload the required scanned documents, photograph, and signature as per the specified guidelines.
  5. Pay the application fee of ₹750 (uniform for all categories) online using Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, either immediately or any day before 24.08.2026.
  6. After registration, note down and safely preserve the Registration Number provided for future reference.
  7. Check all details carefully before final submission; avoid submitting multiple applications for the same post.

PRL Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Candidates should ensure they fully meet the eligibility criteria before applying, to avoid disappointment later.
  • Candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply only with the permission of their employer and must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview, failing which their candidature will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed second-class train fare (shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the interview venue; change of city/address for this purpose is not entertained. No TA is paid for the written test.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of interview.
  • If any information furnished online is found false, the candidate will not be interviewed and TA will not be paid.
  • PRL reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the posts.
  • Only Indian nationals can apply.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted at, or transferred to, any Unit of PRL/Department of Space at any time.
  • The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • The answer key will be published on the PRL website within 3 working days of the written test date. Candidates have 5 days to raise objections via email only to [email protected].
  • In case of any discrepancy between the English and Hindi versions of the advertisement, the English version will prevail.
  • For clarifications, refer to the FAQs on the PRL website; if doubts persist, email [email protected].

Candidates with an MBA, M.Com, or Post Graduate degree in relevant streams can also explore more Government Officer Jobs and MBA Government Jobs across India. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, Perks at 35% of Basic Pay, HRA and other benefits including CPF, Gratuity, Social Security Schemes and Medical benefits, as per AAI Rules.   • Application Verification / Subsequent Tests, as applicable to the post

  2. Go to the "CAREERS" tab and select the online application link for Advt No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT.
  3. Register using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
  4. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and category details.

Indian Navy SSC Officer Vacancy 2026 – Branch-wise Details

The Indian Navy SSC vacancy 2026 is spread across 12 branches and cadres. The following table provides a complete branch-wise breakdown of vacancies along with gender eligibility and date-of-birth requirements. Candidates must identify their eligible branch based on their educational qualification stream before applying.

Indian Navy Officer Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Understanding the Indian Navy SSC officer eligibility 2026 is the most critical step before filling the application. Eligibility differs by branch - both in terms of educational qualification streams and date-of-birth range. Candidates must meet conditions of nationality as laid down by the Government of India.

Educational Qualification – Branch-wise

The minimum educational requirement for most branches is a BE/B.Tech degree with minimum 60% marks in the relevant discipline. Here is a branch-wise summary of qualification requirements:

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/Hydro): BE/B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. Candidates must have 60% aggregate in Class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII.
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks; 60% aggregate in Class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII.
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Same as Pilot / Observers entry.
  • Logistics: (a) BE/B.Tech in any discipline with First Class; OR (b) MBA with First Class; OR (c) B.Sc/B.Com/B.Sc (IT) with First Class along with PG Diploma in Finance/Logistics/Supply Chain Management/Material Management; OR (d) MCA/M.Sc (IT) with First Class.
  • Naval Armament Inspectorate Cadre (NAIC): BE/B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in streams including Mechanical, Aeronautical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics, Micro Electronics, Industrial Production, Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Communication, Industrial Engineering, Aero Space, Control Engineering, Information Technology, Production, Instrumentation, Applied Electronics & Instrumentation, Electronics & Tele Communication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Application, Metallurgy, Metallurgical, Chemical, Material Science; OR Post Graduate degree in Electronics/Physics. Candidates must have 60% aggregate marks in Class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII.
  • Education: Multiple streams accepted including MSc/MA in Maths/Operational Research/Physics/Applied Physics/Meteorology/Oceanography/Atmospheric Sciences, MA (History) with min 55%, BE/B.Tech in Mechanical/Production/Electrical/Electronics/Communication/Electronics and Instrumentation, ME/M.Tech in Electronics/Communication/Controls/Radar/Microwave/Optical Fibre Communication/Digital Signal Processing/VLSI etc., ME/M.Tech in Thermal/Production/Machine Design/Mechatronics/Meteorology/Oceanography/Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation). Minimum 60% marks in Class X, XII, and minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or XII.
  • Engineering Branch (GS): BE/B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Marine Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Aero Space Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Control Engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Metallurgy Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: Same as Engineering Branch (GS).
  • Electrical Branch (GS): BE/B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics & Instrumentation, Instrumentation, Tele Communication, Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics, Power Engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: Same as Electrical Branch (GS).
  • Naval Constructor: BE/B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation, Civil Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Marine Engineering, Ship Technology, Naval Architecture, Metallurgy, Ship Building, Ship Design, Ocean Engineering.

Age Limit – Indian Navy Officer Recruitment 2026

The Indian Navy officer age limit 2026 varies by branch. Refer to the vacancy table above for branch-specific date-of-birth ranges. All candidates must be unmarried at the time of applying. The selected candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant.

Who Can Apply?

  • Candidates who have obtained a graduate/post-graduate degree or are in the final year.
  • Degree must be from a university incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India, or other institutions established by Act of Parliament or deemed to be Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007, IIT Act 2014.
  • Candidates studying in the possession of a degree from foreign institutions may also apply for any Branch/Cadre as enumerated above, with an equivalence certificate of the degree from UGC.

Indian Navy SSC Selection Process 2026

The Indian Navy SSC selection process 2026 is a multi-stage procedure that begins with shortlisting based on normalised marks and culminates in a merit list after SSB interview and medical examination. Understanding each stage will help candidates prepare strategically for this defence government job.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting for SSB Interview

Shortlisting will be done using formulae mentioned on the Indian Navy website (https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf). Marks obtained by candidates in the qualifying degree will be considered for SSB shortlisting.

  • BE/B.Tech candidates: Marks obtained up to the fifth semester will be considered. For candidates in the final year, shortlisting will be based on final-year performance.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme candidates: For those who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered.

Stage 2 – SSB Interview

Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS. Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/mobile number till selection process is over and to check their inbox and spam folder periodically. Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.

Stage 3 – Medical Examination

SSB-recommended candidates will be required to inform their final result of their respective degree to the Indian Navy at [email protected] prior to 20 June 2027. Candidates declared fit in the medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

Stage 4 – Merit List

A merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries, after medical clearance for the respective entry. Mere inclusion in the select list does not confer a vested right to appointment. All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued from time to time.

Indian Navy Officer Salary 2026

One of the most frequently searched topics for this recruitment is the Indian Navy officer salary 2026. Selected candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant. Here are the key pay and allowance details as mentioned in the official notification:

  • The initial gross salary of a Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,20,000/- (approximately) per month, along with other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/NAOO and Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Further details on pay, allowances, Group Insurance and Gratuity/Leave Entitlements/Duties of Officers are available on the Indian Navy website at www.joinindiannavy.gov.in.

Tenure of Commission

Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years, extendable by a maximum of 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility, and willingness of candidates.

Indian Navy SSC Probation Period

Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation, officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.

Indian Navy Physical and Medical Standards 2026

Candidates are strongly advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference. This is especially relevant for SSC (Pilot) entry where specified numbers of candidates based on service requirement will be considered for SSB/CPSS/Aviation Medical Examination.

  • A specified number of candidates for SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/CPSS/Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/medical standards (Height, leg length etc.) before selecting this option.
  • Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates declared medically fit for DG Jul 27 course will be considered fit for all SSC branches of IN (except for Pilot/NAOO).
  • Please visit www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB-recommended candidates must undergo medical examination applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible under any circumstances.

Training Details – Indian Naval Academy

Candidates selected for the Indian Navy SSC Jun 2027 (AT 27) Course will undergo training at the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, Kerala. Key training-related points are as follows:

  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant, subject to clearing induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala upon posting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate found to be married or who marries during training will be discharged from service.
  • Candidates must fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by June 2027. The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • Male candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies, and service requirements.

Apply Online – Indian Navy SSC Officer 2026

Candidates who meet the Indian Navy SSC eligibility criteria 2026 can apply online through the official Indian Navy recruitment portal. The online application process is active from 25 June 2026 and the final deadline is 03 August 2026. No applications will be accepted after the last date.

Important instructions before applying:

  • Candidates must register and fill the application on the Indian Navy website at www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling the e-application, keep the following documents readily available:
    • Correct personal particulars (as given in Matriculation Certificate)
    • Valid e-mail address and mobile number (mandatory fields)
    • CGPA covering up to 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree programmes
    • All relevant documents (preferably mark sheets up to 10th & 12th certificate)
    • Date of birth proof (as proof of 10th or 12th certificate)
    • NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps (if applicable)
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph in original JPG/TIFF format
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable, the application will be rejected. Candidates must take a printout of the application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.
  • Multiple applications for this course by any candidate will lead to cancellation of his/her candidature.

Indian Navy SSC Officer 2026 Apply Online Link: Apply Here

Common Application Mistakes to Avoid

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for defence jobs in India 2026. Based on general guidance for government online application processes, here are common mistakes to be careful about:

  • Uploading blurred, low-resolution, or incorrectly formatted photographs and documents - these lead to rejection.
  • Entering incorrect personal details that do not match your Matriculation Certificate.
  • Selecting a branch for which you do not meet the educational qualification or stream requirement.
  • Failing to include CGPA/marks for all required semesters as specified for your course type.
  • Changing your registered mobile number or e-mail address after submission - you may miss SSB shortlisting communications.
  • Submitting multiple application forms - this will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Not taking a printout of the submitted application - candidates must carry it to the SSB interview.

These dates apply uniformly to all three posts - Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility requirements differ for each post. Detailed criteria are given below.

TMB Relationship Manager Eligibility 2026

  • Cadre: Manager / Assistant Manager
  • Educational Qualification: Any Graduation or Post Graduation in first class (60% marks) in any discipline under a regular stream from a recognised university.
  • Age Limit: Not more than 35 years as on 30.06.2026
  • Experience: For Manager - at least 3 years of relevant experience in a bank in sourcing / processing loans / MSME loans / retail loans. For Assistant Manager - at least 2 years of relevant experience in the same areas.
  • Tenor: Regular basis
  • Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate.

TMB Product Specialist (Trade Finance) Eligibility 2026

  • Cadre: Manager / Senior Manager
  • Age Limit: Minimum 28 years and not more than 38 years as on 30.06.2026 (age may be relaxed in deserving cases).
  • Educational Qualification: Any Graduate / Post Graduate from a recognised university under a regular curriculum. Holding a Certified Credit Professional certification and a certification in Foreign Exchange Operations by IIBF is desirable.
  • Experience: At least three years of experience in handling Trade Finance business.
  • Tenor: Regular basis
  • Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from DAC/Vigilance/RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate.

TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches Eligibility 2026

  • Age Limit: Not more than 62 years as on 30.06.2026
  • Who Can Apply: Retired officers of TMB or other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement.
  • Cadre at Retirement: Officers must have retired in Scale II, Scale III, or Scale IV cadre. Preference will be given to those with previous work experience in the inspection/audit department.
  • Track Record: Only suitable persons with a good track record and unblemished service are eligible.
  • Disqualification: Officers removed or dismissed from bank service under disciplinary measures are not eligible.
  • Contract Period: Initially engaged for 1 year, renewable for a further 1 year based on satisfactory performance (total 2 years).

TMB Recruitment 2026 Salary and Remuneration

Post Salary / Remuneration
Relationship Manager Not specified in the official notification (regular officer cadre - Manager/Assistant Manager)
Product Specialist (Trade Finance) As applicable to regular officers (Manager / Senior Manager cadre)
Mobile Inspector of Branches Consolidated pay of ₹35,000/- per month. No other allowance or perquisite such as bonus, ex-gratia, variable pay, LFC, or medical reimbursement will be paid. However, lodging expenses and halting allowance applicable to the respective cadre will be paid.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

There is no application fee for any of the three posts - Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches. Candidates from all categories can apply free of cost.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process is common for all three posts:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview.
  • The interview will be conducted through Direct mode or Video Conferencing.
  • The mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates individually.
  • The bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection will be final.

Roles and Responsibilities

Relationship Manager - Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and acquire new customers.
  • Promote and cross-sell banking products such as CASA, loans, insurance, and investment products.
  • Achieve assigned sales and business targets.
  • Ensure KYC compliance, handle customer portfolio management, and coordinate onboarding.
  • Assess customer background and risk using CIBIL, CRILC, and Account Aggregator tools.
  • Conduct property and collateral verification using Proplegit for home loans.
  • Visit accounts in SMA 0, 1, and 2 categories along with the collection officer.

Product Specialist (Trade Finance) - Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for trade finance customers in the region.
  • Facilitate onboarding of new trade finance clients in compliance with regulatory policies.
  • Provide expertise on letters of credit (LCs), bank guarantees, documentary bills collection, trade loans, and export/import financing.
  • Cross-sell cash management, foreign exchange, and treasury solutions.
  • Evaluate creditworthiness and assess risks associated with trade finance transactions.
  • Oversee preparation and verification of trade finance documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist internal and external auditors during trade finance reviews.

Mobile Inspector of Branches - Key Responsibilities

  • Verify that branch activities comply with the bank's internal policies, RBI regulations, and statutory requirements.
  • Check compliance with KYC and AML norms and scrutinise cash transactions for irregularities.
  • Examine loan and advance portfolios, verify cash balance and vault holdings.
  • Identify operational, credit, trade finance, and compliance risks; check for fraud-prone areas.
  • Inspect pledged/mortgaged security items such as gold and title deeds, and verify CCTV/alarm/fire safety systems.
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports covering observations, irregularities, risks, and recommendations.
  • Submit findings to the Regional Office/Head Office Inspection Division and follow up on earlier recommendations.

  • Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof.
  • Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate(s).
  • Experience certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employments.
  • Last month's salary slip.

  1. Visit the bank's official careers website: ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/
  2. Read the detailed advertisement by clicking "Download Advertisement" under the relevant post title, and confirm your eligibility before applying.
  3. Click "Apply Online" and register yourself for the appropriate post using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
