Airports Authority of India (AAI), through EdCIL (India) Limited, has released the AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 notification for 10 vacancies. The recruitment is being conducted for the posts of Senior Consultant (Law), Consultant (Content Writer), Consultant (Graphic Designer), Consultant (Video Editor), Senior Consultant (Clinical Psychologist), and Consultant (Clinical Psychologist) on a contract basis. To apply for these positions, candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualifications and relevant post-qualification work experience as specified for each post. The upper age limit is 40 years for Consultant posts and 45 years for Senior Consultant posts.

Interested candidates must go through the complete article to check eligibility criteria, vacancy details, remuneration, selection process, and other important information before applying. The online application process commenced on 24th July 2026 at 10:00 hrs, and the last date to submit the online application is 06th August 2026 at 23:59 hrs.

Notification PDFs: Senior Consultant (Law Directorate) | Consultants (Corporate Communications) | Consultants (Clinical Psychologists)

AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Organization Airports Authority of India (AAI), through EdCIL (India) Limited
Advt. Nos. 11/2026/CHQ/CN (Law), 01/2026/CHQ/CN (Corporate Communications), 10/2026/CHQ/CN (Clinical Psychologist)
Posts Senior Consultant (Law), Consultant (Content Writer), Consultant (Graphic Designer), Consultant (Video Editor), Senior Consultant (Clinical Psychologist), Consultant (Clinical Psychologist)
Total Vacancies 10 (05 Law + 03 Corporate Communications + 02 Clinical Psychologist)
Application Start Date 24 July 2026, 10:00 hrs
Application Last Date 06 August 2026, 23:59 hrs
Mode of Application Online
Nature of Engagement Contract basis - 1 year (Law & CC, extendable) / 3 years (Clinical Psychologist)
Job Location Corporate Headquarters, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi and RHQ, Northern Region, Delhi

Important Dates

Online Application Start Date 24 July 2026, 10:00 hrs
Last Date to Apply Online 06 August 2026, 23:59 hrs
Cut-off Date for Qualification, Experience & Age 06 August 2026

The above dates apply uniformly to all three engagements listed in this article.

AAI Consultant Vacancy Details

A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across Law (05), Corporate Communications (03), and Clinical Psychology (02) directorates.

Directorate Post Code Position Location No. of Posts
Law 01 Senior Consultant Corporate Headquarters (CHQ) 04
Law 01 Senior Consultant RHQ, Northern Region, New Delhi 01
Corporate Communications 01 Consultant (Content Writer) CHQ / RHQ, Northern Region 01
Corporate Communications 02 Consultant (Graphic Designer) CHQ / RHQ, Northern Region 01
Corporate Communications 03 Consultant (Video Editor) CHQ / RHQ, Northern Region 01
Clinical Psychology 01 Senior Consultant CAP Directorate, Corporate Headquarters, Delhi 01
Clinical Psychology 02 Consultant RHQ, Northern Region, Delhi 01
    Total   10

Eligibility Criteria

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for all posts.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post should submit a separate application for each post.
  • For the Law post, qualification must be from National Law Universities, other Universities established by Acts of Central or State legislature, or institutions declared as Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, recognised by the Bar Council of India.
  • For Corporate Communications posts, qualifications should be from approved recognized institutions.

Senior Consultant (Law Directorate)

Qualification Required Experience
Professional degree in Law (3 years regular course after graduation OR 5 years integrated regular course after 10+2); candidate should be eligible to get himself enrolled as an Advocate in the Bar Council of India to practice in courts in India. 08-10 years of legal work experience.

Consultants (Corporate Communications Directorate)

Post Name Qualification Required Experience
Consultant (Content Writer) Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, or English Literature from a recognised university, OR Bachelor's degree in any stream with a Master's Degree in Mass Communication/Journalism. Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience in content writing, copywriting, or editorial roles within reputed organizations, agencies, or digital platforms; experience creating long-format content and scripts for audio-visuals, social media articles, blogs, advertising, and marketing collaterals; strong academic background with proven excellence in written and verbal English communication.
Consultant (Graphic Designer) Minimum Bachelor's Degree in any stream with Advanced Diploma/Degree in Multimedia/Animation, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, or related disciplines from a recognised university. Strategic understanding of brand design and creative direction; experience leading design projects or managing a creative team; strong portfolio highlighting versatility, conceptual thinking, and design leadership.
Consultant (Video Editor) Minimum Bachelor's Degree in any stream with Diploma/Degree in Film Production/Media Studies, Mass Communication/Visual Arts, or Animation from a recognised university. Minimum 5-8 years of proven experience as a Video Editor in a professional setup, preferably in TV media, advertising, digital media, broadcasting, or a creative agency environment; experience working on social media videos, brand films, promotional videos, event coverage, interviews, documentaries, and corporate communications content.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Content Writer: Ability to craft clear, concise, grammatically accurate, and engaging content in English & Hindi; creative and conceptual thinking; ability to interpret complex data or subjects and convert them into simplified, engaging narratives.
  • Graphic Designer: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro) and Corel Draw; strong sense of typography, colour theory, layout, and visual hierarchy; digital design skills including social media creatives, infographics, GIFs, and banner design. Applicants must submit a comprehensive portfolio.
  • Video Editor: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Audition, Media Encoder); knowledge of DaVinci Resolve/Final Cut Pro/Avid Media Composer; understanding of video composition, pacing, transitions, colour grading, audio mixing, and motion graphics.

Consultants (Clinical Psychologists, CAP Directorate)

Post Name Qualification Experience
Senior Consultant M.Phil in Clinical Psychology with a valid RCI License. Required: Minimum 8 years of experience in a clinical or academic setting after Bachelor's in Psychology, including at least 2 years specifically as a Clinical Psychologist in a clinical setting.
Desirable: 1 year of experience as a Clinical Psychologist in the Aviation Sector.
Consultant M.Phil in Clinical Psychology with a valid RCI License. Required: Minimum 5 years of experience in a clinical or academic setting after Bachelor's degree in Psychology.
Desirable: 1 year of experience as a licensed Clinical Psychologist in a hospital/clinical setting.

Age Limit

Directorate Post Name Upper Age Limit

Corporate Communications Consultant (Content Writer) 40 years
Corporate Communications Consultant (Graphic Designer) 40 years
Corporate Communications Consultant (Video Editor) 40 years
Clinical Psychology Senior Consultant 45 years
Clinical Psychology Consultant 40 years

Age will be reckoned as on the cut-off/closing date, 06 August 2026, for all posts.

Charter of Duties

Senior Consultant (Law Directorate)

  • Conduct legal research on issues relating to aviation laws, contracts, service matters, land acquisition, arbitration, constitutional and administrative law.
  • Prepare Case Briefs, notes, and other documents pertaining to litigation of AAI.
  • Liaise and coordinate AAI's litigation before various courts and tribunals.
  • Pursue court cases and attend hearings before courts and tribunals on behalf of AAI.
  • Draft, vet, and review legal documents including contracts, agreements, MoUs, affidavits, pleadings, written submissions, rejoinders, replies, notices, and correspondence; process profession fee bills of Lawyers.
  • Maintain litigation and legal data on the AIMS (or other designated) Portal.
  • Coordinate with departments, airports, and Corporate & regional offices for documents, reports, and records required for litigation.
  • Assist in maintaining records of court orders, judgments, legal opinions, contracts, and arbitration awards.
  • Perform other legal, research, or litigation duties as assigned by RED NR and GM (Law), CHQ.

Also read: AIIMS NORCET 11 Recruitment Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Nursing Officer Posts

Consultant (Content Writer)

  • Draft, edit, and proofread communication materials including press releases, articles, reports, speeches, and digital content, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

Consultant (Graphic Designer)

  • Create visually appealing and professional graphics for invitations, backdrops, hoardings, social media content, brochures, and other promotional materials.

Consultant (Video Editor)

  • Handle editing and production of multimedia content, transforming raw footage into engaging, polished video products.

Senior Consultant (Clinical Psychologist)

  • Coordinate with medical and HR teams for selection of ATCOs, ensuring quality and accuracy of verification methods.
  • Plan and conduct periodic training on mental health promotion for ATCOs.
  • Conduct Mental Status Examinations and interviews on referred or self-walk-in ATCOs.
  • Administer, score, and interpret psychological tests for informed diagnosis.
  • Support the medical team in evaluating fitness for safety-sensitive duties.
  • Engage in psychoeducation and provide referrals for additional care when necessary.
  • Visit outstation airports for mental health promotion lectures as required.
  • Actively participate in the Peer Support Programme, maintaining confidentiality.
  • Maintain quarterly databases of ATCO personality and cognitive profiles submitted by RHQ psychologists.
  • Make presentations on enhancing ATCO mental wellbeing per DGCA guidelines.

Consultant (Clinical Psychologist)

  • Coordinate with the Clinical Psychologist at CAP, CHQ for ATCO selection and verification.
  • Plan and conduct periodic training on mental health promotion for ATCOs.
  • Conduct Mental Status Examinations and interviews on referred or self-walk-in ATCOs.
  • Administer psychological tests in consultation with the Clinical Psychologist at CAP, CHQ.
  • Support the medical team in evaluating fitness for safety-sensitive duties.
  • Provide counselling/psychotherapy for ATCOs and families, maintaining standardized records shared with CAP, CHQ.
  • Visit outstation airports for mental health promotion lectures as required.
  • Actively participate in the Peer Support Programme, maintaining confidentiality.
  • Maintain and submit quarterly databases of ATCO personality and cognitive profiles to CAP, CHQ.
  • Make presentations on enhancing ATCO mental wellbeing per DGCA guidelines.

Selection Process

  • Selection for all posts will be based on academic qualifications, experience, document verification, and interview.
  • Preliminary shortlisting will be based on documents uploaded with the online application.
  • Documents supporting Qualifications, Experience, and Age must be uploaded with the application and produced in original at the time of Document Verification and interview.
  • In case of false or insufficient information, candidature will be summarily rejected at any stage.

How to Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates can apply online from 24 July 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 06 August 2026 (23:59 hrs) for the respective post(s).
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
  • Ensure the email ID provided in the online application remains active, as call letters and further communication will be sent only by email.
  • Mere submission of the application or meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview/selection.
  • For queries: Law Directorate - Helpline +91 9819703925; Corporate Communications - Helpline +91 9819703724; Clinical Psychologist - Helpline +91 9819703801.

Also read: AAI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out for 389 Manager & Junior Executive Posts, Apply Online Starts August 8

Remuneration

  • Senior Consultant (Law Directorate): Rs. 1,50,000/- per month (all inclusive)
  • Consultant (Content Writer): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month (all inclusive)
  • Consultant (Graphic Designer): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month (all inclusive)
  • Consultant (Video Editor): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month (all inclusive)
  • Senior Consultant (Clinical Psychologist): Rs. 1,50,000/- per month (all inclusive)
  • Consultant (Clinical Psychologist): Rs. 1,20,000/- per month (all inclusive)

Important Instructions

  • Law & Corporate Communications posts: engagement is purely contractual, initially for 1 year. The Law post is extendable by 1 year at a time up to a cumulative maximum of 5 years; the Corporate Communications posts are extendable as per requirement and rules.
  • Clinical Psychologist posts: engagement is purely contractual, initially for a period of 3 years.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/selection process for any post.
  • Leave will be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service; unavailed leave cannot be carried forward or encashed.
  • AAI reserves the right to upgrade the eligibility criteria if a large number of applications are received.
  • AAI reserves the right to cancel, modify, withdraw, or postpone any of these engagement notices.
  • Candidates should note the respective Advertisement Number for future reference.

IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026: Vacancy Details

Why Was the Reserve List Released?

After the CRP RRBs-XIV final result, a primary list of selected candidates was allotted to participating rural banks. However, some sanctioned posts remained vacant because certain selected candidates did not join within the deadline, resigned soon after joining, or were excluded during document verification. To ensure these vacancies are filled, IBPS has released this reserve list for candidates who cleared the exam but were not allotted a bank in the first round.

How to Check IBPS RRB Clerk Reserve List 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website at ibps.in.

  4. Enter your Registration No/Roll No and Password/Date of Birth.
  5. Enter the captcha code and click Login.
  6. Check your provisional allotment status and download it for future reference.

  • Specific documents required for verification are not listed in the official notification. Candidates should follow the instructions issued directly by their allotted bank.
  • Candidates should keep checking their registered email and SMS regularly to avoid missing further communication or deadlines.

What Happens After Reserve List Allotment?

Based on the notification, candidates allotted through the reserve list can expect the following process, though exact dates and requirements are not specified:

  • Document Verification
  • Submission of Required Certificates
  • Medical Examination (if applicable)
  • Joining Formalities
  • Induction/Training Process

IOB Chief Financial Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

All eligibility criteria (Qualification, Age, Experience, etc.) for this post shall be computed as on 01.07.2026 (inclusive).

Educational/Professional Qualification

  • A qualified Chartered Accountant
  • Preferred: FRM Certification and/or CFA

Work Experience

Minimum fifteen (15) years in overseeing financial operations, preferably accounting and taxation matters, in Banks/large corporates/PSUs/FIs/financial services organizations, of which ten (10) years should be in Banks/FIs, of which five (5) years should be at Senior Management level.

Age Limit

Maximum age 55 years (inclusive of applicable age relaxation), as on 01.07.2026.

Nationality/Citizenship

A candidate must be either:

  • a Citizen of India, or
  • a subject of Nepal, or
  • a subject of Bhutan, or
  • a Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania (formerly Tanganyika and Zanzibar), Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia and Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India.

Candidates belonging to categories (ii), (iii), (iv) and (v) above must possess a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India before the date of this notification.

IOB Chief Financial Officer: Roles & Responsibilities

  • Financial Reporting & Compliance: Overseeing the statutory auditing process, reporting audit results as per SEBI requirements, monitoring critical financial parameters (Non-Interest Income, ROA, ROE etc.), coordinating with NFRA and RBI on auditor-related issues, and handling Whole Bank Long Form Audit Report (WBLFAR) matters.
  • Tax Compliance: Optimization of the Bank's tax liability, GST and TDS compliance.
  • Accounting Systems: Developing and maintaining accounting systems per Accounting Standards and RBI Guidelines, Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCOFR), and implementation of IFRS/IND AS.
  • Management Reporting: Coordinating with the Financial Control Department for review of regional and Whole Bank performance.
  • International Banking Activities: Supporting the International Banking Group on accounting and tax compliance as per local regulators.
  • Other Activities: Overseeing MIS reporting systems, strategic capital planning, balance sheet optimization, medium-term financial strategy, and managing stakeholder relationships with regulators, government, rating agencies, and investors.

  • Selection will be through Personal Interview/Discussion. The Bank may carry out a preliminary screening of applications to shortlist eligible candidates based on qualifications, suitability, and experience.
  • Total marks allocated for the Personal Interview: 100.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 50 (45 for OBC/SC/ST/PwBD candidates).
  • In case multiple candidates score the same cut-off marks, ranking will be done according to age, in descending order.
  • The Bank may change the mode of selection depending on the number of applications received.
  • Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to an interview call; the Bank may consider additional qualifications, greater experience, and level of responsibilities handled while shortlisting.

  • The selected candidate, at the time of joining, must execute a Bond of Rs. 3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a stipulated period of 3 years. The Bond will be invoked if the candidate resigns before the expiry of the bond period from the date of joining.
  • On joining, the selected candidate will be on probation for a period of 1 year and subjected to continuous assessment. Confirmation depends on qualifying the assessment as per standards determined by the Bank.

  1. Visit the Bank's official website www.iob.bank.in and go to the "Careers" page.
  2. Click on "RECRUITMENT OF CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER" and select the post to be applied for.
  3. Click on the "Register Online" link and complete first-time registration by clicking "Click here to Register Online".
  4. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent via email and SMS.
  5. Upload photograph and signature as per the specifications in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature (Annexure I).
  6. Fill in all required details carefully in the Online Application Form.
  7. Upload the mandatory documents: Birth/SSC Certificate, Final Degree Certificate/Consolidated Mark Sheet, CA Certificate, and Work Experience Certificate (PDF, each under 200KB); upload NOC from employer, if applicable.
  8. Click on "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" at the end of the form.
  9. Proceed to pay the Application Fee/Intimation Charges through Online Mode (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking).
  10. Take a printout of the system-generated submitted online application form and the payment e-receipt for future reference.

IOB Chief Financial Officer Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted online only from 22.07.2026 to 05.08.2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.
  • If a candidate applies multiple times, only the last submitted application will be considered.
  • Application once made cannot be withdrawn, and the fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances nor adjusted against any other recruitment process.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright.
  • No change of category will be permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category under the creamy layer must indicate their category as General in the online application form.
  • Reserved category candidates (including PwBD) for whom no reservation has been announced are free to apply against General category vacancies, provided they fulfil all eligibility criteria.
  • Request for change in Personal Interview dates, centre, or communication address/email ID will NOT be entertained.
  • Outstation eligible SC/ST/PwBD candidates who are unemployed and attend the Personal Interview will be reimbursed to-and-fro second-class ordinary train fare by the shortest route, on production of evidence of travel, as per extant Government guidelines.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Reservation is as per extant Government Guidelines.
  • In case of any dispute in interpretation, the English version of the advertisement shall prevail, and disputes are subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts situated at Chennai.
  • The version of the detailed advertisement on the Bank's official website shall be treated as final and shall supersede any other version.

Chartered Accountants exploring senior finance leadership roles can also check more Bank CFO and General Manager Recruitment notifications and PSU Bank Senior Management Jobs across India. Candidates based in Tamil Nadu can also browse the latest Chennai Government and PSU Jobs, while finance professionals with CA/CFA/FRM qualifications can explore more Chartered Accountant Government Jobs and Bank Recruitment 2026 notifications matching their profile.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

For posts up to Scale III, selection may comprise Online Examination, Group Discussion (if required), and/or Personal Interview, depending on the number of applicants. For posts in Scale IV, V, and VI, selection may comprise Group Discussion (if required), any other test/assessment, and/or Personal Interview. There is a penalty of 25% of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.

Personal Interview

A Personal Interview of 100 marks assesses academic and job knowledge, power of expression, clarity of thought, leadership qualities, communication skills, and suitability for the post. Minimum qualifying marks: 50 for General/EWS, 45 for Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD). Candidates are called for interview in the ratio of 1:3 against the number of vacancies (subject to change at the Bank's discretion).

Final Merit

Final selection is based on the aggregate marks of Online Examination and Personal Interview (or Personal Interview alone, or GD/other assessment plus Personal Interview, depending on which stages are conducted), prepared in descending order category-wise, up to the number of vacancies. Punjab National Bank (PNB) has invited online applications for recruitment to 545 posts of Local Bank Officer (LBO) in Junior Management Grade Scale-I (JMGS-I). The vacancies are distributed across 17 states, and candidates can apply for only one state based on their eligibility and language proficiency. Online registration is open from 20.07.2026 to 09.08.2026. This article covers all details of the notification, including state-wise vacancies, eligibility, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

  • Official Notification: Recruitment of Local Bank Officers in Punjab National Bank
  • Apply Online: Direct Link to Apply for PNB LBO Recruitment 2026

A total of 545 vacancies are notified across 17 states/UTs. Candidates must apply for only one state and must be proficient in the mandatory local language specified for that state. Key Points on Vacancy Distribution

  • Candidates belonging to reserved categories for which no vacancy has been announced in a state may apply against Unreserved (UR) vacancies of that state, if they meet UR eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates can apply for a vacancy in one state only. Applying against one state makes a candidate ineligible to apply against any other state.
  • The merit list will be drawn state-wise and category-wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted within the selected state until completion of nine (9) years of service or promotion to SMG Scale IV, whichever is earlier.
  • Prior experience will not be considered for seniority in service.
  • PwBD reservation is on a horizontal basis; selected PwBD candidates will be placed in their applicable category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR) and posted within the state applied for, at locations identified suitable by the Bank.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality/Citizenship

An applicant must be:

  • A citizen of India, or
  • A subject of Nepal, or
  • A subject of Bhutan, or
  • A Tibetan Refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India.

Candidates in the last four categories must have a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India before the date of this notification, and must also be proficient in the local language of the state applied for.

Candidates who have completed their graduation in any discipline can also explore more Bank Officer Jobs and Graduate Government Jobs available across India.

The candidate must possess a valid Mark-sheet/Degree Certificate confirming graduate status on the day of registration, and must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering online.

Local Language Requirement

Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, and speaking the specified local language of the state for which they are applying (as listed in the state-wise vacancy table). A Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) will be conducted by an external agency for candidates who have not studied the local language as a subject in Class 10 or Class 12.

Post-Qualification Experience

  • Candidates must possess a minimum of one year of post-qualification work experience in Clerical/Officer Cadre in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or Regional Rural Bank listed in the Second Schedule of the RBI Act, 1934.
  • One advance increment is payable for each completed prior year of service as an Officer in Scheduled Commercial Banks (subject to a maximum of 2 increments), if the job profile matches that of a Scale-I Generalist Officer of PNB.
  • Candidates from subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks (Officer cadre) are eligible for only one advance increment under the same condition.
  • Proof of prior experience must be submitted in the prescribed format, duly certified by the previous employer.
  • Experience in other financial institutions will not be considered if the job profile does not substantially match that of a PNB Scale-I Generalist Officer.
  • No prior service/experience will be considered for seniority purposes.

Cut-off Dates for Eligibility

  • Age: Reckoned as on 01.07.2026
  • Mandatory Experience: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • Educational Qualification: Reckoned as on the closing date for online registration, i.e., 09.08.2026
  • The result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before 09.08.2026.
  • Candidates must indicate the percentage obtained in Graduation to the nearest two decimals; CGPA/OGPA must be converted to percentage as per the university's official conversion formula. A fraction of percentage will be ignored (e.g., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%).

Selected candidates will draw pay in the scale of Rs. 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 under JMGS-I. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), City Compensatory Allowance (CCA), HRA/Leased Accommodation, Leave Fare Concession, Medical Insurance, Retirement Benefits, and other perquisites as per Bank rules.

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and cannot be reserved for any other examination.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection for the post of Local Bank Officer shall be conducted in four phases. The Bank reserves the right to decide whether all or any of these modes shall be adopted:

  1. Online Written Test
  2. Screening
  3. Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT), if applicable
  4. Personal Interview

Online Written Test Structure

Name of the Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Sectional Duration (Minutes)
Reasoning & Computer Aptitude 25 25 35
Data Analysis & Interpretation 25 25 35
English Language 25 25 25
Quantitative Aptitude 25 25 35
General/Economy/Banking Awareness 50 50 50
  • There is negative marking: one-fourth of the marks assigned to each question is deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS category, 35% for Reserved category, in each section. The Bank reserves the right to revise this at its discretion.

Screening

The online application and submitted documents of written-test-qualified candidates will be scrutinized to confirm eligibility before the Language Proficiency Test/Interview. Candidates found ineligible or with incorrect/false documents at any stage will be rejected from further participation.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

  • Candidates who have not studied the applied-for state's local language as a subject in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT.
  • The LLPT is qualifying in nature; candidates must secure the Bank-prescribed minimum qualifying marks to be considered for final selection.
  • Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT are treated as ineligible for final selection, irrespective of performance in other stages.
  • Candidates who indicate they studied the local language in Class 10/12 are exempt from LLPT, subject to submission of valid documentary evidence at verification.

Personal Interview

  • All candidates shortlisted after qualifying the Online Written Test will be called for interview.
  • The Personal Interview carries 50 marks.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 45% (22.50 marks) for SC/ST candidates; 50% (25 marks) for other candidates.
  • Candidates who fail to secure minimum qualifying marks in the interview will be disqualified.

Final Selection

  • Final selection is based on combined performance in the Online Written Test and Personal Interview, subject to qualifying the LLPT (where applicable).
  • Candidates who fail the LLPT are ineligible for final selection even if they qualify in the written test and interview.
  • The merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.
  • In case of a tie, the older candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher in the merit list.

How to Apply for PNB LBO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB website: https://pnb.bank.in/, under Recruitment/Career.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic personal details to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent via Email/SMS).
  3. Re-login using the Provisional Registration Number and Password to complete the application form.
  4. Upload scanned images of photograph, signature, left-hand thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per prescribed specifications (see below).
  5. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details before clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" - no changes are allowed after this step.
  6. Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment gateway (Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, IMPS, Wallets, or UPI).
  7. On successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated.
  8. Take a printout of the submitted application form and e-receipt for personal record; do not send these to the Bank.

Applications are accepted online only, from 20.07.2026 to 09.08.2026, through https://pnb.bank.in/. No other mode of application will be accepted.

PNB LBO Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Candidates who have earlier worked in PNB or its merged/amalgamated entities and were discharged for reasons other than VRS/Resignation are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates against whom there are adverse reports regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply.

NaBFID Business Analyst Eligibility Criteria 2026

Educational Qualification

  • No change in category is permitted after registration of the online application; no correspondence, email, or phone call will be entertained regarding category change.

PwBD Eligibility

Horizontal reservation is provided to Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (RPwD), 2016. The identified categories for this recruitment are Visual Impairment (VI) and Hearing Impaired (HI):

  • Visual Impairment: Includes blindness (total absence of sight, or visual acuity less than 3/60 in the better eye, or field of vision limited to less than 10 degrees) and low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/18 up to 3/60, or field of vision limited to less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees) after best correction.
  • Hearing Impaired: Hard of Hearing means 60 dB to 70 dB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears.

PwBD candidates must produce a certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines. Disability conditions classified as "likely to improve" under a temporary category are not eligible for reservation; conditions that are progressive, non-progressive, or not likely to improve are treated as eligible.

NaBFID Business Analyst Job Profile (Stream-wise)

Lending Operations (Lending & Project Finance)

  • Credit appraisal and financial analysis of lending proposals, including financial statements, business models, cash flow projections, sponsor strength, project risk, security structure, and repayment capacity.
  • Validation of project financial models against the Techno-Economic Viability (TEV) report, industry benchmarks, and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordination on loan documentation, verification of sanction terms and Conditions Precedent (CPs), and initiation of disbursement.
  • ESG monitoring, tracking Early Warning Signals (EWS), and periodic asset quality review.
  • Credit monitoring and portfolio management, including covenant compliance and risk mitigation recommendations.

Investment & Treasury

  • Settlement and accounting of treasury trades, reconciliation and balancing of books, and valuation of securities.
  • Timely submission of regulatory statements, audit reports, and MIS.
  • Exposure to finance and treasury activities including banking, cash and liquidity management, and capital and debt markets.

Accounts

  • Support the Bank's financial reporting, financial planning, and analysis in line with statutory standards.
  • Preparation and analysis of financial statements and management information for strategic decision-making.
  • Financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
  • Engagement with auditors, tax authorities, and regulators on financial reporting, accounting, and taxation matters.

Risk Management

  • Credit risk assessment of new proposals in line with existing policies and SOPs.
  • Periodic review of the existing portfolio, including internal credit ratings and rating rationale.
  • Monitoring of regulatory and management exposure limits at account and group level.
  • Assistance in determining provisioning requirements and developing/testing internal credit rating models.

Internal Audit

  • Planning, executing, and reporting on Risk Based Internal Audit covering business operations, infrastructure lending/project finance, and support functions.
  • Evaluating internal controls, governance mechanisms, and risk management processes in line with RBI and NaBFID policies.
  • Process walkthroughs, control testing, and preparation of audit reports with findings and recommendations.
  • Support for the Annual Audit Plan and follow-up reviews for audit compliance.

Compliance

  • Design and strengthening of the Bank's Compliance Governance Framework in line with the NaBFID Act and RBI guidelines.
  • Preparing compliance reports, dashboards, and updates for the Board, Audit Committee, and other Board-level committees.
  • Monitoring regulatory circulars and notifications from RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI, CBDT, IRDAI, MCA, and international bodies.
  • Advisory support on AML/CFT, KYC/CDD, sanctions compliance, and beneficial ownership requirements.

Across all streams, candidates should possess excellent communication skills and proficiency in the use of computers and information technology.

NaBFID Business Analyst Salary 2026

  • Annual fixed compensation: approximately Rs. 16.67 lakh.
  • Variable pay (performance bonus) of up to 20% of fixed compensation, based on performance, as decided by the Bank.
  • Compensation may be revised at suitable intervals, as approved by the Board.
  • Group Insurance (Medical, Accidental, and Term Life) is provided over and above the compensation mentioned above.

APCOB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Local Candidate (Domicile) Eligibility

Each DCCB recruits only for its own district's requirements, so candidates must be local to the erstwhile district of the post they are applying for. For example, only candidates local to erstwhile Chittoor district can apply for Chittoor DCCB posts, and only candidates local to erstwhile Kadapa district can apply for Kadapa DCCB posts, and so on for Nellore, Prakasam, Visakhapatnam, and Vizianagaram. Local status is generally determined based on either of the following:

  • Having studied in an educational institution in the local area for at least 4 consecutive academic years up to the SSC (or equivalent) examination; or
  • Having resided in the local area for at least 4 years immediately preceding the SSC (or equivalent) examination, if not covered under the study criterion above.

Candidates who do not meet the 4-year local criterion may still be considered local under a 7-year study/residence criterion within the state, as detailed in the respective official notification.

The age of the candidate is reckoned as on 01.06.2026.

  • Minimum age: 20 years
  • Maximum age: 30 years (for open market candidates, both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager)
  • Maximum age for PACS in-service candidates: Relaxation up to 45 years for OC, with further category-wise relaxation subject to an overall ceiling of 50 years

APCOB Age Relaxation 2026

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Backward Class 3 years
Physically Challenged – General 10 years
Physically Challenged – SC/ST 15 years
Physically Challenged – BC 13 years
Ex-Servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen Actual period of service rendered + 3 years (8 years for disabled ex-servicemen belonging to SC/ST), subject to a maximum age of 50 years
In-service candidates of Cooperative/Commercial banks Age relaxed by the period of continuous service, subject to a maximum age of 35 years (General), 38 years (BC), and 40 years (SC/ST)

The relaxation in upper age limit is cumulative as per government guidelines, and reserved-category candidates must submit the relevant community certificate at the time of document verification to claim age relaxation.

APCOB Salary 2026 (Pay Scale and Emoluments)

Post Pay Scale Approximate Starting Monthly Emoluments
Staff Assistant ₹24,050 – 1340/3 – 28,070 – 1650/3 – 33,020 – 2000/4 – 41,020 – 2340/7 – 57,400 – 4400/1 – 61,800 – 2680/1 – 64,480 Around ₹47,000 per month, inclusive of DA and HRA at current rates
Assistant Manager ₹40,480 – 2000/11 – 62,480 – 2340/2 – 67,160 – 2680/5 – 80,560 Around ₹62,571 per month, inclusive of DA and HRA at current rates

Other allowances and perquisites are admissible as per the service rules of the respective Bank. Selected candidates are required to execute a Contract Bond with a liability of ₹2,00,000, agreeing to serve the Bank continuously for a minimum period of 2 years; this bond condition applies to both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager appointees.

APCOB Application Fee 2026

The application fee/intimation charges (non-refundable) are the same across all six DCCBs and both posts, and must be paid online only.

Category Fee (Inclusive of GST)
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen ₹590
OC / BC / EWS ₹826

Bank transaction charges for online payment are additional and must be borne by the candidate, including those applying under reserved categories. Payment can be made using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, UPI, or mobile wallets.

How to Apply Online for APCOB Recruitment 2026?

Candidates can apply only through the official website of the DCCB corresponding to the post/district they wish to apply for, and only during the online registration window. Follow the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website of the concerned DCCB (Chittoor, Kadapa, Nellore, Prakasam, Visakhapatnam, or Vizianagaram DCCB, as applicable).
  2. Click on the "Apply Online" link on the homepage.
  3. Select "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  4. Log in using the generated credentials and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and other required details.
  5. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
  6. Preview the application form carefully before final submission, since no correction is allowed after clicking "Completed Registration."
  7. Pay the requisite application fee/intimation charges through the online payment gateway.
  8. Submit the application and save/print the system-generated e-receipt and application form for your own records.

Before starting the online registration, keep ready a scanned photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), signature in black ink, left thumb impression, and a handwritten declaration in English, since these need to be uploaded during the application process.

APCOB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection to both Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager posts (open market category) is based purely on performance in the Online Written Test, followed by document verification and a medical fitness check. There is no interview for either post. The broad stages are:

  • Stage 1: Online Written Examination
  • Stage 2: Document Verification
  • Stage 3: Medical Fitness Examination
  • Stage 4: Final Appointment (subject to executing the service bond)

APCOB Exam Pattern 2026 (Open Market Candidates)

The online test for Staff Assistant and Assistant Manager (open market candidates) will be conducted in English, carries 200 marks, and has a composite duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.

Quantitative Aptitude (with Data Interpretation for AM) 40 50 40 50

Computer Knowledge 40 20 40 20
Total 200 200 200 200

APCOB Exam Pattern 2026 for PACS In-Service Candidates (Staff Assistant Only)

Candidates applying under the PACS quota for Staff Assistant posts will be tested separately, on the working and functions of PACS.

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Working and Functions of PACS 50 100

The same negative marking rule of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applies to this test as well. The Certified PACS Secretary (CPS) study material (4 modules) has been indicated as the reference material for this test.

APCOB Recruitment 2026 Required Documents

Candidates shortlisted for document verification should be ready with the originals and photocopies of the following documents. Candidates are not required to send these to the Bank at the time of online application; they need to be produced only when called for verification.

  • Printout of the online application form and fee payment e-receipt
  • Downloaded call letter with the same photograph affixed as uploaded during registration
  • Valid photo identity proof (as specified in the call letter)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (SSC onward)
  • Local candidate / domicile proof for the concerned district
  • Community/Caste certificate, for candidates seeking SC/ST/BC reservation or age relaxation
  • Income and Asset Certificate, for candidates seeking EWS reservation
  • PwBD disability certificate in the prescribed format, for candidates seeking disability-based reservation
  • Discharge certificate, for Ex-Servicemen candidates
  • PACS service certificate/service register (duly certified), for in-service PACS candidates
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, if already employed

APCOB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one online application should be submitted per post; details cannot be modified after final submission.
  • Signature must not be in capital letters and must be in black ink; the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only.
  • Candidates already employed must produce a "No Objection Certificate" from their current employer at the time of document verification.
  • Bank transaction charges for the online fee payment are to be borne by the candidate and are not included in the fee amount shown above.
  • Candidates using a scribe (visually impaired or those with a permanently affected writing speed) are eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination, subject to prior registration for the same in the application form.
  • Canvassing in any form, or furnishing incorrect information at any stage, will lead to disqualification from the selection process, potentially with retrospective effect.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being declared medically fit and executing a Contract Bond of ₹2,00,000 for a minimum 2-year service commitment.
  • Candidates should keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process, since call letters and other communication will be sent through these channels.

This article covers the complete vacancy breakup, eligibility, age limit, application fee, selection process, and the step-by-step online application procedure, based on the official notification.

BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

BDCC Bank has published the detailed recruitment notification on its official website. Candidates should read it carefully before applying, since objections about eligibility are not entertained once an application has been submitted.

BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Applicants must be citizens of India.
  • Applicants must be able to read, write, and speak Kannada.
  • Applicants can apply for only one post; if a candidate applies for more than one post, only the first submitted application is considered valid.
  • Candidates already in service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer.

BDCC Bank Second Division Clerk Educational Qualification

Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree (BA/B.Sc/B.Com) from a university legally established and recognized in India. Basic knowledge of computer operation and applications is required for this post; if a candidate has completed at least one computer-related course, the certificate for it may be submitted voluntarily.

BDCC Bank Gun Man Educational Qualification

Applicants must have passed SSLC/10th standard or an equivalent examination, and should either be retired armed-forces personnel with weapons training or an ex-serviceman, and must hold a valid Arm License.

Applicants must have passed SSLC/10th standard or an equivalent examination.

BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection is through a Written Examination followed by an Interview, conducted as per the method prescribed by the Karnataka State Cooperative Societies Registrar's office.

A merit list is prepared based on written exam marks. Candidates are shortlisted for interview in a 1:5 ratio against each post. The interview carries a maximum of 15 marks. The final merit list is prepared by combining written exam marks and interview marks, and candidates are selected as per the applicable reservation policy. Details of the exam admission letter, date, and exam schedule will be announced on the bank's website.

Documents Required for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026

Selected/shortlisted candidates must produce the following original documents at the time of verification:

  • Marks card / transcript / provisional degree certificate / convocation certificate for the qualifying education
  • SSLC (or equivalent) certificate showing date of birth, or an Extract of Cumulative Record, or a government-issued birth certificate / School Leaving (Transfer) Certificate
  • Caste/category certificate for candidates claiming reservation benefits
  • Non-creamy layer certificate, where applicable
  • Computer knowledge proof certificate — required only for Second Division Clerk applicants, not for Peon or Gun Man posts
  • No Objection Certificate from the current employer, for candidates already in service

How to Apply Online for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the official BDCC Bank website, www.belagavidccb.bank.in, and click on "BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026."
  2. Read the notification and instructions carefully, accept the terms and conditions, and click "Open Application" to proceed.
  3. Click "Apply" against the relevant post and fill in the application form. Verify all entered details carefully, then click "Preview."
  4. On the Preview page, use "Edit" to correct any details if needed, upload a passport-size photograph, and click "Next." (A Registration ID and Password will be sent to your registered email for future edits — keep these safe.)
  5. Upload your scanned photograph and signature. The photograph must be under 100 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 4.5cm) with a plain background, and the signature under 50 KB (approx. 3.5cm x 2.0cm). Once submitted, the photo/signature cannot be changed.
  6. Upload self-attested scanned copies of all relevant certificates — educational qualification, caste/category proof, computer knowledge proof, etc.
  7. Click "Pay Online" to pay the prescribed application fee along with the applicable bank gateway charges through the e-payment gateway.
  8. Click "Print Application" after previewing, and download a copy of your submitted application. Keep this printout for future reference — the file size of the printed application copy must be less than 100 KB when uploading it wherever required.

BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for only one post; if applications are submitted for more than one post, only the first submitted application is treated as valid.
  • Applications submitted through an agent, agency, or courier will not be accepted.
  • Applications with incomplete or unclear information, or submitted without the prescribed fee, will be rejected.
  • Requests for reconsideration, complaints, or queries related to this recruitment sent by letter, email, or phone will not be entertained.
  • The bank reserves the right to cancel or withdraw this recruitment notification at any stage.
  • Candidates' own travel expenses for the written exam and interview must be borne by themselves.
  • The bank's Recruitment Committee's decision on any matter relating to eligibility, acceptance, or rejection of applications is final.

Who Cannot Apply for BDCC Bank Recruitment 2026

As per the notification, the following categories of persons are not eligible to apply:

  • Persons who are not citizens of India.
  • Persons disqualified under the Representation of the People Act, 1972, for corrupt election practices.
  • Persons convicted of a criminal offence by a court of law.
  • Persons dismissed from bank service.
  • Persons dismissed or removed from Central/State Government service, or from a public sector or cooperative institution, for corruption or misconduct.
  • Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude and not since rehabilitated.
  • Persons who, having a living spouse, married another person (or vice versa).
  • Members of an unlawful body or organization, or persons in contact with such bodies.
  • Persons who do not respect the Constitution of India, or have acted against India's sovereignty and integrity, state security, public order, or friendly relations with foreign states, or have insulted the national flag, anthem, or emblem.
  • Persons debarred by any competent authority from government or cooperative institution recruitment or examinations for adopting unfair means such as impersonation or cheating.
  • Persons who are medically unfit for the post.
  • Persons currently in service whose employer does not release them / provide a No Objection Certificate.

  • The E-Call Letter (Admit Card) becomes available approximately 4 days before the date mentioned in the City Intimation Slip.
  • The first Admit Card release is reported as 31st July 2026.
  • Since the CBT is being conducted in multiple phases through August 2026, City Intimation Slips and Admit Cards will continue to be released in batches closer to each phase's exam dates.
  • Candidates must carry the Admit Card to the exam centre; entry will not be permitted without it.

Also Read: RRB Group D Physical Exam Date 2026

RRB Group D CBT Exam Pattern 2026

The Computer Based Test consists of objective-type multiple-choice questions with negative marking for wrong answers.

Section No. of Questions Marks
Mathematics 25 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30 30
General Science 25 25
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20 20
Total 100 100
  • Exam Duration: 90 minutes (1 hour 30 minutes)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each incorrect answer
  • Candidates who clear the CBT will be shortlisted for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

RRB Group D Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Test (CBT)
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

Aadhaar-Based Biometric Authentication: Important Instructions

The official notice places strong emphasis on Aadhaar verification for CEN 09/2025 candidates:

  • Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication is mandatory at the exam centre before entry into the exam hall.
  • Candidates must carry either their original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar.
  • Candidates who have not completed Aadhaar verification are advised to do so in advance by logging into the official portal with their registered credentials.
  • Even candidates who verified Aadhaar during the application stage must ensure their Aadhaar status is "unlocked" in the UIDAI system before arriving at the centre. A locked Aadhaar can cause avoidable delays during registration on exam day.
  • Candidates are advised to check their Aadhaar lock/unlock status on the official UIDAI portal a few days before the exam.

How to Check RRB Group D Exam City, Date and Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB region (linked via rrbapply.gov.in).
  2. Look for the "CEN 09/2025 Group D - City Intimation Slip / Admit Card" link once it is activated for your phase.
  3. Log in using your registration number and date of birth or password.
  4. Download and take a printout of the City Intimation Slip and, later, the Admit Card.
  5. Verify your Aadhaar unlock status on the UIDAI portal before the exam date.

RRB Group D 2026: What Candidates Should Do Next

  • Revise core subjects: Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Science, and General Awareness on Current Affairs.
  • Practice previous years' RRB Group D papers and full-length mock tests.
  • Keep login credentials for rrbapply.gov.in ready for Aadhaar verification and e-call letter download.
  • Check the official RRB regional website regularly for exam city, date, and admit card updates specific to your phase.

The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) is being conducted from 25th July 2026 to 11th September 2026, with dates varying by zone. As of 30th July 2026, PET schedules have been announced for Ajmer, Chennai, Prayagraj, Bhopal, Bilaspur, Chandigarh, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Mumbai zones, while some zones (including Patna and Hubballi) have been postponed and several others are yet to release their schedule. This article covers the complete zone-wise PET dates, PET criteria, admit card details, and required documents.

RRB Group D PET Dates 2026: Zone-Wise Schedule

The table below lists the current status of the RRB Group D PET schedule for every RRB/RRC zone. Dates marked "Not Yet Announced" have not been released by the concerned RRC as of 30th July 2026.

RRB Group D Ajmer PET Exam Date 2026

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Jaipur has scheduled the PET for candidates shortlisted under CEN No. 08/2024 from 29 July to 31 July 2026, with 1 August 2026 kept as a final opportunity for candidates unable to appear earlier for valid reasons. The test is being held at G.L.O. Ground, A.D.S.A. Stadium, near DRM Office, Mall Road, Ajmer. Male candidates must report at 6:00 AM, and female/transgender candidates at 9:00 AM on the final PET day. Candidates must carry their e-call letter, original photo ID, and original Aadhaar card candidates without these documents will not be permitted to appear.

RRB Group D Prayagraj PET Exam Date 2026

The RRB Group D Prayagraj PET was conducted from 25 to 28 July 2026 at DSA Ground, near Prayagraj Railway Station. The RRC, North Central Railway has already declared the PET result, with 251 candidates qualifying for the next stage Document Verification and Medical Examination.

RRB Group D Chennai PET Exam Date 2026

The Southern Railway zone's PET is scheduled from 29 to 31 July 2026. Candidates should download their e-call letter from the official RRC Chennai website and carry the required identity documents to the venue.

RRB Group D Patna PET Exam Date 2026 (Postponed)

The PET originally scheduled for 28-29 July 2026 under RRC, East Central Railway (Patna) has been postponed due to administrative reasons. Free travel passes issued earlier to eligible SC/ST candidates for the postponed dates have also been cancelled. The revised date is Not Yet Announced; candidates should keep checking the official RRC Patna website.

RRB Group D Hubballi (Bengaluru) PET Exam Date 2026 (Postponed)

The South Western Railway zone's PET, originally set for 30-31 July 2026, has been postponed until further notice. The revised schedule will be published on the official RRC Hubballi website.

RRB Group D PET Criteria 2026

The PET is qualifying in nature and must be completed successfully in a single attempt. Candidates who fail the first component are not permitted to attempt the second.

Category Requirement
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg for 100 metres within 2 minutes, in a single chance, without dropping the weight
Run 1000 metres in 4 minutes 15 seconds, in a single chance
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg for 100 metres within 2 minutes, in a single chance, without dropping the weight
Run 1000 metres in 5 minutes 40 seconds, in a single chance

Documents Required for RRB Group D PET 2026

  • PET e-call letter (printed copy)
  • Original photo ID proof
  • Original Aadhaar card
  • Any additional document specified in the zone-specific e-call letter

Document requirements may vary slightly by zone. Candidates should always check the instructions listed on their own e-call letter before travelling to the venue.

How to Download RRB Group D PET Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the concerned RRC/RRB zone (e.g., rrcjaipur.in, rrb.digialm.com, rrchubli.in check the zone applicable to you).
  2. Look for the "RRB Group D PET Admit Card / e-Call Letter CEN 08/2024" link.
  3. Log in using your registration number and date of birth or password.
  4. Download and take a printout of the e-call letter.
  5. Carry the printed admit card along with the required documents to the PET venue.

The e-call letter is also sent via SMS and email to the registered mobile number and email ID of shortlisted candidates.

RRB Group D PET 2026: Important Instructions

  • Only candidates provisionally shortlisted after the CBT are eligible to appear for the PET.
  • Report to the venue at the reporting time mentioned on the e-call letter; late entry may not be permitted.
  • Both PET components (lift-and-carry and running) must be completed in a single attempt.
  • Candidates without a valid e-call letter and original ID/Aadhaar will not be allowed to appear.
  • PET is qualifying only; no marks are added to the final merit list.
  • Candidates found attempting to influence the RRC may have their candidature cancelled, and legal action may follow.
  • Keep checking the official RRC website of your zone regularly for venue, reporting time, and any date revisions.

The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have announced that the Computer Based Test (CBT) for CEN 09/2025, covering various posts in Level 1 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (commonly known as RRB Group D), will be held from 3rd August 2026 to 21st August 2026. This tentative schedule was released via an official notice dated 3rd July 2026, signed by the Chairpersons of the Railway Recruitment Boards. Candidates who registered under CEN 09/2025 can use this page to track the exam window, city/date intimation link, e-call letter download, and Aadhaar-related exam day requirements.

RRB Group D Exam Date 2026 - Quick Overview

RRB Group D (CEN 09/2025, Level 1) CBT exam dates: 3rd August 2026 to 21st August 2026. The notice was issued on 3rd July 2026. This is a tentative schedule; RRBs have stated that the exact city, date, and shift for each candidate will be intimated separately closer to the exam.

Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), Ministry of Railways, Government of India
Notification No. CEN 09/2025
Post Level Various posts in Level 1 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (RRB Group D)
Exam Type Computer Based Test (CBT)
Tentative CBT Exam Dates 3rd August 2026 to 21st August 2026
Notice Release Date 3rd July 2026
Official Website www.rrbapply.gov.in

Important Dates for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

As per the official notice, the RRB Group D CBT will run for close to three weeks, from 3rd August to 21st August 2026, with related downloads opening in a fixed window before each candidate's exam date.

Event Date
Notice of Tentative CBT Schedule Released 3rd July 2026
CBT Exam Dates (Tentative) 3rd August 2026 to 21st August 2026

How to Download the RRB Group D Exam City Slip and E-Call Letter

The official notice confirms that both the city/date intimation link and the e-call letter will be published on the official websites of all RRBs, not on this or any third-party platform.

  1. Visit the official website of your respective Railway Recruitment Board (or www.rrbapply.gov.in).
  2. Look for the CEN 09/2025 (Level 1) link on the homepage once it is activated around 10 days before your exam date for the city/date intimation, and around 4 days before for the e-call letter.
  3. Log in using your registration credentials (registration number and password/date of birth).
  4. View or download your allotted exam city and date, and later your e-call letter, once each link goes live.
  5. Keep a printed and digital copy of the e-call letter for exam day.

Also Read: RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

Is Aadhaar Mandatory for the RRB Group D Exam?

Yes. Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication is mandatory at the exam centre before entry into the exam hall. Candidates must carry their original Aadhaar card or a printout of an e-verified Aadhaar. If a candidate has not already completed Aadhaar authentication, this should be done by logging in at www.rrbapply.gov.in.

What Should Candidates Check Regarding Aadhaar Before Exam Day?

Even candidates who already verified their Aadhaar during the application stage are advised to ensure their Aadhaar remains in an unlocked condition in the UIDAI system before arriving at the exam centre, to avoid delays during registration and entry.

Important Instructions from the Official RRB Notice

  • This is a tentative schedule; candidates should keep checking official RRB websites for updates.
  • Candidates should refer only to official RRB websites for recruitment updates and avoid unauthenticated third-party sources for critical decisions.
  • RRBs have specifically cautioned candidates to beware of touts making fake promises of appointment in exchange for illegal consideration. Selection is based purely on CBT performance and merit, with no role for unofficial intermediaries.
  • SC/ST candidates can download their Travel Authority from the same city/date intimation link once it is live.

Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 27th July 2026 on the official website www.gujaratmetrorail.com. A total of 11 vacancies have been announced through the GMRC Recruitment 2026 for the posts of Chief General Manager/General Manager (Civil), Manager (Traction), Assistant Manager (Rolling Stock), Engineer - Senior Grade (M&P), and Engineer - Junior Grade (Rolling Stock).

Candidates up to 57 years of age for CGM/GM posts, 40 years for Manager, 35 years for Assistant Manager, and 32 years for Engineer posts who possess a B.E./B.Tech. in the relevant engineering discipline along with the prescribed post-qualification work experience are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process for GMRC Recruitment 2026 has already commenced and will remain open until 12th August 2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Chief General Manager/General Manager (Civil): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a Government-recognized University/Institute recognized by the State/Central Government or other statutory authority.
  • Manager (Traction): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute.
  • Asst. Manager (Rolling Stock): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Power Electronics/Instrumentation or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute.
  • Engineer - Sr. Grade (M&P): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Power Electronics/Instrumentation engineering or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute.
  • Engineer - Jr. Grade (Rolling Stock): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics & Communications/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Power Electronics/Instrumentation engineering or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute.

Required Work Experience

Post Experience Requirement
CGM (Civil) Minimum 23 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization; OR minimum 20 years in Government Organizations/Indian Railways/PSUs/Metro Rail Corporations, of which at least 17 years at Executive level, including minimum 4 years in SAG/GM grade (7th CPC Level-14 or IDA scale ₹120000-280000 or equivalent)
GM (Civil) Minimum 20 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization; OR minimum 17 years in Government Organizations/Indian Railways/PSUs/Metro Rail Corporations, of which at least 14 years at Executive level
Manager (Traction) Minimum 9 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization, OR 7 years in Government organisation/PSU/Metro Rail Corporation, in planning, technical specification, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals, or maintenance of electric traction/HV Power systems
Asst. Manager (Rolling Stock) Minimum 7 years relevant post-qualification experience at Supervisory grade in a reputed private organization, OR 5 years at Supervisory grade in Government/PSU, related to Rolling Stock systems
Engineer - Sr. Grade (M&P) Minimum 3 years post-qualification relevant experience in tender document preparation, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, or maintenance of Machines & Plants in modern urban metro rail systems or railways
Engineer - Jr. Grade (Rolling Stock) Minimum 2 years relevant experience in planning, technical specification, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals, or maintenance of Rolling Stock systems

Candidates with experience of working in modern urban metro rail systems will be given preference for all posts. For Civil posts, candidates with proven experience of timely project completion as heads of site teams shall be preferred, and must mention a reference from Senior Management who oversaw those projects.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Salary/Pay Scale

Post Remuneration

Manager (Traction) Revised IDA scale of ₹60000-180000; for deputation, as per standard terms & conditions
Asst. Manager (Rolling Stock) Revised IDA scale of ₹50000-160000; for deputation, as per standard terms & conditions
Engineer - Sr. Grade (M&P) Revised IDA scale of ₹35000-110000; for deputation, as per standard terms & conditions
Engineer - Jr. Grade (Rolling Stock) Revised IDA scale of ₹30000-120000; for deputation, as per standard terms & conditions

Apart from pay, other benefits will be paid as per Company Policy. Selected candidates will be extended Group Medical Coverage and Group Personal Accident Insurance Coverage as per GMRCL's governing policies.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is not mentioned in the official GMRC notifications for either the Civil or Systems posts. Candidates are advised to check the official website, gujaratmetrorail.com, for any fee-related updates or corrigenda before applying.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • The selection process comprises Personal Interviews, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post.
  • Preference is given to candidates with experience in the same grade or immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in that grade. If sufficient suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale meeting the prescribed qualifications, total experience, and age criteria may be considered.
  • The selection process evaluates knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude, and physical fitness.
  • The venue, date, and time of the interview will be informed in advance; requests for change in date or venue will not be entertained.
  • Document verification of candidates will be done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates; failing this, they will not be allowed to attend the interview.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents

  • Detailed curriculum vitae
  • Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate
  • Educational Qualification: SSC marksheet/HSC marksheets/Graduation all-year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates
  • Experience/service certificates of past employment, clearly mentioning date of joining, date of relieving, and department worked, along with pay details/payscale/CTC
  • Candidates from private organizations must submit a copy of their latest CTC breakup; applications without CTC breakup will not be considered. Form-16 will be used to arrive at current CTC.
  • Details of current organization: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip, and Form-16 of the last three years
  • Candidates working in PSU/Boards/Organization of Government/Metro Rail Corporations must submit an NOC along with the last 5 years' APAR of the present/previous organization, on or before the date of interview

How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility norms may apply through the online application process at the "Careers" section on the official website, http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com. Only online applications are accepted; no other means or mode of application will be entertained.

  1. Step 1: Register on the portal using basic details such as Name, DOB, category, mobile number, and email ID.
  2. Step 2: A passcode will be sent to the registered email ID. Log in using the credentials.
  3. Step 3: Select the position for which you are applying.
  4. Step 4: Fill in the online application with relevant details, latest to earliest.
  5. Step 5: Complete the application form.
  6. Step 6: Check the entered details using the "preview" option available.
  7. Step 7: Submit the form after verifying all the information. Once submitted, the form cannot be edited.

GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Candidates already working in Indian Railways/Metro Rail Organization/State or Central Government PSU/Board/Organization of Government may apply on a deputation basis as per standard terms & conditions of the parent organization. NOC must be submitted with the application on or before the date of interview.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for at least 3 years and are conversant with the Gujarati language.
  • Eligible officials/staff already working in GMRC who have completed a minimum of two years of service as on 28th July 2026, at their present designation and grade, may apply through the proper channel.
  • Prescribed qualifications are the minimum requirements; mere possession does not entitle candidates to be called for interview or selection.
  • GMRC reserves the right to offer a grade lower than that applied for.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to the advertisement will be displayed only on the company's website; applicants should check regularly for updates.
  • Candidates found guilty of impersonation, submitting fabricated documents, or making false statements will be liable for rejection.
  • The selected candidate must indicate acceptance of the offer within three working days of receipt, failing which the next candidate in order of merit may be offered the appointment.
  • Selected candidates are likely to be posted at Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar/Surat or any other GMRC project location in Gujarat.
  • Any canvassing by or on behalf of candidates, or bringing political or other outside influence regarding selection/appointment, shall lead to disqualification.
  • GMRCL management reserves the right to cancel or amend the advertisement.

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria for engineering and managerial roles can also explore more Government Engineering Jobs and PSU Recruitment 2026 opportunities across India. Applicants interested in metro rail and infrastructure careers can check the latest Gujarat Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those looking for openings closer to Ahmedabad and Surat can browse more Ahmedabad Government Jobs and Surat Government Jobs matching their qualification, along with other Railway Government Jobs notifications from across the country.
