  • All eligible candidates will be called for document verification and trials.
  • Only candidates declared FIT (securing 25 or more out of 40 marks for game skill, physical fitness, and coach's observations during trials) will be assessed further; those declared UNFIT will not proceed.
  • Distribution of marks: Game skill, physical fitness & coach's observations during trials - 40 marks; Assessment of recognized sports achievements as per norms - 50 marks; Educational qualification - 10 marks; Total - 100 marks.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: Level-2 (GP 1900) - 65 marks; Level-1 (GP 1800) - 60 marks.
  • The offer of appointment will be given purely on merit; in case of a tie, preference is given to the younger candidate.
  • Sportspersons recruited as Junior Clerk/Accounts Clerk must pass the requisite typewriting test within 4 years of appointment, failing which regular increments after 4 years will not be released.

RWF Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Documents Required

  • Duly filled Application Form (Annexure-I), printed on good quality white A4 paper
  • One recent passport-size colour photograph (4 cm x 5 cm, not older than 3 months, without cap/coloured glasses, not attested by anyone)
  • Self-attested copies of proof of Date of Birth (Matriculation/10th certificate)
  • Self-attested copies of Educational Qualification certificates
  • Self-attested copies of Sports Achievement certificates (Proforma as per Annexure-II)
  • Caste certificate, wherever applicable (SC/ST/OBC), in prescribed format (Annexure-A/B)
  • Minority/Economically Backward Class declaration, if claiming fee exemption (Annexure-C/D)
  • Discharge Certificate, for Ex-servicemen applicants
  • Domicile Certificate, for candidates from North Eastern states and other specified regions
  • Examination Fee in the form of IPO/DD

How to Apply for RWF Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?

  1. Download the notification and Application Form (Annexure-I) from www.rwf.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Print the application form on good quality white A4 (210 x 297 mm) paper.
  3. Fill the form in your own handwriting using a blue ballpoint pen, in English or Hindi only.
  4. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and provide the required signatures, left thumb impression, and personal identification marks.
  5. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents and the prescribed Examination Fee (IPO/DD).
  6. Write "Application against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement) dated 25.07.2026 - Recruitment for the year 2026-27" on top of the sealed envelope.
  7. Send the application by post to: The Assistant Personnel Officer, Personnel Department, Rail Wheel Factory (Ministry of Railways), Administrative Building, Yelahanka, Bangalore 560064, or drop it in the Drop Box at the Personnel Department office (2nd Floor) at the same address, before the closing date and time.

RWF Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Important Instructions

  • Applications received after the closing date and time will be summarily rejected; RWF will not be responsible for postal or any other delay.
  • Applications not in the prescribed format, incomplete, without signature/left thumb impression, in a language other than English/Hindi, or without required documents and fee, will be rejected.
  • Candidates applying for more than one game/event must submit separate applications with separate Examination Fees.
  • Candidates serving in any Government Department/PSU (including Railways) must submit a declaration of having intimated their employer, and an NOC at the time of trials, failing which their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Candidates debarred from RRB/RRC exams should not apply unless their debarment period is over by the closing date.
  • No TA/DA or accommodation will be provided for document verification/trials (SC/ST candidates are eligible for free rail travel in second class for this purpose).
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of 2 years and must fill and sign a Service Bond (Annexure-E) committing to serve in their sports field for a minimum of 5 years.
  • Candidates recruited against Sports Quota can participate in other sporting/professional activities only with prior sanction of the Government.

The Railway Recruitment Cell, Eastern Railway (RRC/ER), Kolkata has come out with a fresh recruitment drive under the Scouts & Guides Quota for Level-2 (Group C) and Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D) posts. RRC Eastern Railway has released the official notification on 24th July 2026 for recruitment to 15 posts under the Scouts & Guides Quota. Eligible candidates with the required Scouting/Guiding qualifications can apply online from 07th August 2026 to 06th September 2026. In this article, we have provided vacancy details, eligibility criteria, selection process, application schedule, and complete details for RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Quota Recruitment 2026.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27 Notification PDF Out

RRC/ER has published the detailed notification, along with the required certificate annexures, on its official website.

  • RRC ER Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27 Notification PDF
  • RRC ER Scouts & Guides Apply Online
  • RRC/ER Official Website

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27 - Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Railway Recruitment Cell, Eastern Railway (RRC/ER), Kolkata
Notification No. RRC/ER/Scouts & Guides Quota/2026-27 (Open Advertisement)
Notification Date 24.07.2026
Total Vacancies 15
Posts Level-2 (Group C) and Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D)
Quota Scouts & Guides Quota (mandatory Scouting/Guiding qualification)
Application Mode Online
Application Start Date 07.08.2026, 10:00 hrs
Application Last Date 06.09.2026, 18:00 hrs
Selection Process Written Test + Marks on Certificates + Medical Examination
Official Website www.rrcer.org

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27 Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Publication Date 24.07.2026
Online Application Opening Date 07.08.2026, 10:00 hrs
Online Application Closing Date 06.09.2026, 18:00 hrs
Tentative Written Exam Date 2nd week of November 2026
Document Verification (DV) Call Tentatively within 10 days of written exam result

Dates for the written test and other recruitment stages will be intimated from time to time through the RRC/ER website.

Also Read: Northeast Frontier Railway NFR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 6777 Posts

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Vacancy 2026-27

A total of 15 vacancies - 5 posts in Level-2 (Group C) and 10 posts in Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D).

Category Eastern Railway CLW Metro Railway Total Vacancies
Level-2 (Group C) 2 1 2 5
Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D) 8 2 Nil 10

Candidates may apply for Level-1, Level-2, or both categories. Those applying for both must fill separate forms and pay the examination fee separately for each category.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Level-2 (Group C): Passed 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent with at least 50% aggregate marks from a government-recognized Education Board/Council/Institution (the 50% requirement is relaxed for SC, ST, ESM, and PwBD candidates, and for candidates with a higher qualification from a UGC-recognized university); or 10th pass from a government-recognized Board plus a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC)/ITI approved by NCVT (a Diploma in Engineering is not considered an alternative higher qualification).
  • Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D): 10th Pass, or ITI, or an equivalent qualification, or a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

Scouting/Guiding Qualification (mandatory for both Level-1 and Level-2):

  • Must be a President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger, or hold a Himalayan Wood Badge (HWB) in any section.
  • Must have been an active member of a Scout Organization for the last 5 years, supported by a "Certificate of Activeness."
  • Must have attended two events at National level or All India Railways level, and two events at State level.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Reservation Policy

This quota is open to all candidates. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/ESM/PwBD categories get the age relaxation admissible in a general open-market recruitment, but if selected with any such age relaxation, they are taken against a reserve roster point rather than a separate reserved vacancy.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Age Limit

Age will be reckoned as on 01.01.2027.

Category of Post UR OBC SC/ST
Level-2 (Group C) 18 to 30 years Relaxation up to 3 years in upper age Relaxation up to 5 years in upper age
Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D) 18 to 33 years As per the relaxation criteria below

Extent of Age Relaxation:

  • Serving Railway employees (including casual labourers/substitutes with at least 3 years of continuous or broken-spell service): maximum age, for both levels - UR 40 years, OBC 43 years, SC/ST 45 years.
  • Widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated but not remarried: maximum age, for both levels - UR 35 years, OBC 38 years, SC/ST 40 years.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): additional 10 years' relaxation, subject to a Disability Certificate issued by a committee of at least 3 members of a Government Hospital.
  • Ex-servicemen: relaxable to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces plus 3 years, provided they have completed a minimum of 6 months' attested service. Ex-servicemen who have already joined Government civil service after availing ex-servicemen benefits cannot claim ex-servicemen status again for this recruitment.
  • Staff of Quasi-Administrative offices/organizations (e.g., Railway Consumer Co-operative Societies, Canteens, Institutes): relaxation of 5 years or the service rendered in such organization, whichever is less.
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) applying for Level-1: age limit 33 years for UR, 36 years for OBC, and 38 years for SC/ST, plus relaxation for apprentice training undergone (maximum 3 years).

Proof of age: A Birth Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births, or a 10th class Certificate/Admit Card/Mark Sheet showing date of birth, issued by a government-recognized Education Board, is required. The date of birth entered in the application must match the Matriculation/SSLC/10th class certificate; no subsequent request for change will be considered.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Salary Structure

Level-2 (Group C) carries 7th CPC Level 2 with Grade Pay Rs. 1900, and Level-1 (Erstwhile Group D) carries 7th CPC Level 1 with Grade Pay Rs. 1800. An exact gross/take-home salary figure is not specified in the notification.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment Process

Stage-I: Written Test (60 marks)

Consists of 40 objective-type questions (40 marks) and 1 essay-type question (20 marks) relating to the Scouts & Guides Organization and its activities, and General Knowledge - common for both Level-1 and Level-2. Duration is 60 minutes, with a minimum qualifying percentage of 40%. Candidates are called for Stage-II in a 1:3 ratio of notified vacancies, based on merit in Stage-I.

Stage-II: Marks on Certificates (40 marks)

Criteria Marks
Participation/service in National Events/National Jamboree (including All India Railway Events) - first two certificates: Nil; one additional event: 7 marks; two or more additional events: 10 marks 10
Participation/service in State Events/Rallies - same structure as above 10
Specialized Scouts/Guides Course at National/State/All India Railways level - one course: 7 marks; two or more: 10 marks 10
Participation in District Rallies - one certificate: Nil; two certificates: 7 marks; three certificates: 10 marks 10

Total Marks (Stage-I + Stage-II): 100

Candidates must choose either Hindi or English for the written examination. After clearing Stage-I and Stage-II and on the Recruitment Committee's recommendation, candidates are sent for a medical examination at a Railway Hospital, in merit order, in a 1:1 ratio of notified vacancies, and must be declared medically fit for the offered post.

Syllabus for RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Written Exam

History of Scouting/Guiding; Law and Promise; Organisation at District & State level; Training Centres at District & State level; Knowledge of Books; Scouting for Boys/Guiding for Girls in India; Motto, left-hand shake, salute, prayer, flag song, National Anthem; National and Scouting flags; Social Services; Hiking; Proficiency Badges; Stages in Scouting/Guiding; Thinking Day; Progressive Training of Scouts/Guides/Rovers/Rangers; Pioneering; Handicrafts; Indian Railway Jamborette; National Jamboree; Jamboree on the Air; Organization at National level; National Training Centres; WAGGGS/WOSM; Uprastrapati Award Competition; Prime Minister Shield Competition; Community Development Programmes; Aims and Methods of Scouting; and how Scouting is useful in producing better citizens.

Also read: RRB JE 04/2026 Recruitment 2026 Notification Out

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Application Fee

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC / EWS (Male) Rs. 500 (Rs. 400 refundable to candidates who actually appear in the written exam)
SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwBD, Women, Minorities, Economically Backward Classes (EBC) Rs. 250 (fully refundable to candidates who actually appear in the written exam)
  • Fee must be paid online via Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI; service charges are borne by the candidate.
  • Fee paid via Cash, Cheque, Money Order, Central Recruitment Fee Stamps, or Demand Draft will not be accepted, and the application will be rejected.
  • The refund is credited either to the original bank account used for payment or to an alternative beneficiary account provided by the candidate (name, account number, bank name, IFSC code), after deduction of applicable bank charges. Candidates are solely responsible for the accuracy of these details.
  • Minority means Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Zoroastrians (Parsis). Economically Backward Classes (EBC) means candidates whose family income is less than Rs. 50,000 per annum.

Documents Required for RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment

  • Self-attested certificates and mark sheets proving educational qualification and Scouts & Guides qualification, issued by a government-recognized Board/University/Institute.
  • Self-attested proof of age - Birth Certificate/Matriculation/10th Certificate/Admit Card/Marksheet showing date of birth.
  • SC/ST candidates: self-attested community certificate (as per Annexure-I).
  • OBC-NCL candidates: self-attested community certificate (Annexure-II) plus a non-creamy-layer self-declaration (Annexure-IIA).
  • EBC candidates: Income Certificate (Annexure-VII).
  • EWS candidates: Income Certificate (Annexure-VI).
  • Minority candidates: declaration for fee waiver (Annexure-IX).
  • PwBD candidates: self-attested Disability Certificate (Annexure-III, IV, or V, as applicable).
  • Self-attested certificates proving Scouts & Guides achievements.
  • Certificates in languages other than English or Hindi must be accompanied by an attested translation.

At the time of Document Verification, candidates must produce original certificates for both educational and Scouts & Guides qualifications. If the original degree certificate is not yet available, a final mark sheet, a provisional certificate, and an undertaking may be submitted instead, though the appointment offer will remain pending until the original is verified.

Photograph and Signature Specifications

  • Photograph: Colour, passport-size, white/light-coloured background, taken after the notification's publication date in a professional studio (mobile/self-composed photos may lead to rejection). Size 35mm x 45mm or 320x240 pixels, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size between 20-50 KB. Clear front view, no cap or sunglasses, face covering at least 50% of the frame.
  • Signature and Left Thumb Impression (LTI): Signed with black ink on white paper within a 50mm x 20mm box, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size between 10-40 KB. Must be in Hindi or English, not in capital or disjointed letters, and must be the applicant's own.

How to Apply Online for RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27?

  1. Visit the official RRC/ER website (www.rrcer.org) and click on the Online/E-Application link for the Scouts & Guides Quota, then click "New Registration."
  2. Fill in personal information - Name, Father's Name, Date of Birth, Community, e-mail Address, and Mobile Number. A Registration Number and Password will be sent to your registered e-mail/mobile.
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and Password received.
  4. Upload scanned copies of your Photograph, Signature and LTI, and self-attested certificates for date of birth, education/technical qualifications, caste (SC/ST/OBC/EBC/EWS), income certificate, self-declarations, and Scouts & Guides achievements.
  5. Fill up all mandatory fields of the application form and submit it - a Unique Application Number will be generated. Preserve your Registration Number for future stages of the recruitment process.
  6. Take 2 printouts of the properly filled-up application form for your records.

Applications sent manually, or received directly by RRC/ER outside the online portal, will not be entertained. No change is permitted after the final submission of the online application. Candidates are advised to keep their personal mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process, and to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment: Reasons for Rejection

  • Application sent manually and not registered online, or registration of more than one application by the same candidate.
  • Application received after the closing date, or submitted without the prescribed fee.
  • Application incomplete, illegible, or missing Date/Thumb Impression, or signed in block/capital letters.
  • Application without a proper scanned photograph, signature, LTI, or required certificates.
  • Candidate not possessing the prescribed educational or Scouts & Guides qualification at the time of applying.
  • Overage, or date of birth not filled or wrongly filled.
  • Photograph not uploaded, black-and-white, with cap/sunglasses, disfigured, or otherwise unrecognizable.
  • Any other irregularity considered invalid by RRC/ER (this list is illustrative, not exhaustive).

Also Read: RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

RRC Eastern Railway Scouts & Guides Recruitment 2026-27 Important Instructions

  • Candidates found using unfair means, impersonating another person, or furnishing false information will be debarred for life from all RRB/RRC examinations and Railway appointments, and may face legal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Eligible SC/ST candidates opting for free travel will be issued a Free Railway Travel Authority for attending the Written Examination and Document Verification.
  • Candidates must bring the e-call letter, a valid original photo ID (Voter Card, Aadhaar Card, e-Aadhaar, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport, or Employer ID for Government employees), and 4 passport-size photographs to the written test.
  • No TA/DA/Accommodation will be provided for the written test; candidates may need to arrange their own stay for 2-3 days.
  • RRC/ER reserves the right to fix, change, or postpone the date and venue of the written test, or cancel it, without any claim being entertained.
  • Serving Government employees must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
  • Possession or use of mobile phones and other electronic devices inside the examination premises is strictly prohibited, and violation will lead to cancellation of candidature along with possible criminal/disciplinary action.
  • Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must acquire typing proficiency of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi within 2 years of appointment; until then, the appointment remains provisional.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any disputes lies with the Hon'ble Central Administrative Tribunal, Kolkata.
  • Eastern Railway has not appointed any agent or coaching centre for this recruitment; candidates should report any such claims to the Sr. Deputy General Manager cum Chief Vigilance Officer, Eastern Railway, Kolkata, and the local police.

Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MPMRCL), a joint venture of the Government of India and the Government of Madhya Pradesh, has released Advertisement No. 4573/HRD/MPMRCL-077/2026 dated 23 July 2026, Bhopal, inviting applications from qualified and experienced candidates for various posts under the Civil domain. MPMRCL is implementing the Bhopal Metro Rail Project and Indore Metro Rail Project in Madhya Pradesh. Applications are invited on Deputation, Contract, or Re-employment basis.

MPMRCL Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Organisation Madhya Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (MPMRCL)
Advertisement No. 4573/HRD/MPMRCL-077/2026
Advertisement Date 23/07/2026
Posts General Manager / Additional General Manager (Domain - Civil)
Mode of Appointment Deputation / Contract / Re-employment
Mode of Application Offline (by post, in prescribed Annexure-I format)
Last Date to Apply 24/08/2026, till 5:00 P.M.

MPMRCL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 23 July 2026
  • Last Date for Submission of Application: 24 August 2026, till 5:00 P.M.

The notification does not mention a separate application start date; candidates may begin preparing and posting their applications as per the prescribed format from the date of release of the notification.

MPMRCL Vacancy Details 2026

The vacancy has been announced under the Civil domain/sub-domain as follows:

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 General Manager / Additional General Manager (Civil) 2

As per the general conditions of the notification, the number of posts indicated may vary based on further assessment of requirement by MPMRCL.

MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a Government-recognized university or institute.

Work Experience Required

Candidates should have knowledge and working experience in Metro/Railways/RRTS/High Speed Railway Infrastructure projects. Preference is given to candidates with experience in underground transport tunnels, underground stations, and cross passages using TBM/NATM/Cut & Cover methods in Metro/Railways/RRTS/High Speed Railway Infrastructure projects. Candidates should be well versed with activities across the project life cycle, including:

  • Construction of stations, viaducts, and bridges
  • Preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR)
  • Planning and design
  • Estimation and tendering
  • Construction monitoring and project management
  • Civil works and commissioning of the project

Post-Qualification Experience and Present Pay - General Manager

Candidates should presently be working/have worked in Railways/Railway PSUs/Metro organisation/Metro PSUs OR a Government Organisation, meeting the following criteria:

  • For Contract/Deputation basis: Minimum 21 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently in IDA pay scale of ₹1,20,000-2,80,000 or CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above, OR working for 2 years in IDA pay scale ₹1,00,000-2,60,000, OR working for 4 years in CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC), OR drawing a consolidated pay of minimum ₹1,40,000/- per month or above while working at the level of GM/E-8 or above in a Government Organisation.
  • For Re-employment basis: Minimum 21 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently working or retired from IDA pay scale of ₹1,20,000-2,80,000 or above, OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-14 (7th CPC) or above.

Post-Qualification Experience and Present Pay - Additional General Manager

  • For Contract/Deputation basis: Minimum 18 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently in IDA pay scale of ₹1,00,000-2,60,000 or above or CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above, OR working for 2 years in IDA pay scale ₹90,000-2,40,000 or 2 years in CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above, OR drawing a consolidated pay from a Government Organisation of minimum ₹1,15,000/- per month or above while working at the level of Additional General Manager-E7 or above.
  • For Re-employment basis: Minimum 18 years post-qualification experience, including 7 years’ experience in the relevant field/sub-domain, AND presently working or retired from IDA pay scale of ₹1,00,000-2,60,000 or above, OR CDA Pay Matrix Level-13A/13 (7th CPC) or above.

S. No. Post/Mode of Appointment Age Limit
1 Deputation Maximum 58 years at the cut-off date of eligibility, where the retirement age in the parent organisation is 60 years; OR Maximum 60 years, where the retirement age in the parent organisation is 62 years (for working officers)
2 Re-employment Minimum 55 years, Maximum 63 years
3 Contract Maximum 57 years

As per the notification, experience and age will be reckoned as on the closing date of the advertisement.

MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil 2026 Salary Structure

Post Grade Mode Pay Scale (IDA)
General Manager E-8 Contract ₹1,20,000 - 2,80,000 (IDA)
Deputation Parent pay plus Deputation Allowances & other applicable allowances OR pay & allowances of MPMRCL as per rules of the corporation
Re-employment Consolidated pay for retired officers: Retired from Level 14 - ₹1,65,900/- per month, plus other applicable allowances
Additional General Manager E-7 Contract ₹1,00,000 - 2,60,000 (IDA)
Deputation Parent pay plus Deputation Allowances & other applicable allowances OR pay & allowances of MPMRCL as per rules of the corporation
Re-employment Consolidated pay for retired officers: Retired from Level-13A - ₹1,42,300/- per month; Retired from Level-13 - ₹1,27,400/- per month, plus other applicable allowances

Apart from the pay mentioned above, other benefits will also be paid as per the Company Policy.

MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • MPMRCL reserves the right to shortlist any candidate for interview. Priority for shortlisting will be given based on relevant Metro experience and seniority in the desired pay scale. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through the registered e-mail ID provided at the time of application submission. No separate communication by post will be sent.
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to appear for an interview through online or offline mode on the scheduled date and time, along with all original documents, testimonials, and experience certificates.
  • No request for change in the schedule date and time of the interview will be entertained.
  • Management reserves the right to conduct a written test for the posts, if required.
  • MPMRCL may relax the selection criteria in case of candidates with good experience in a similar project.
  • Candidates shortlisted for the screening process will be eligible for reimbursement of train fare as per MPMRCL policy, if the interview is scheduled through offline mode.

Required Documents for MPMRCL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must enclose all self-certified copies of the following documents along with the application:

  • Age proof (Matriculation Certificate or equivalent)
  • Essential Qualification certificate as prescribed in the notification
  • Experience certificate(s) of ex-employer(s), Appointment order/Office order of joining the current organisation
  • Office order showing present pay-scale and promotion to present grade
  • Summarised brief description of relevant experience
  • Latest salary slip (3 months)
  • NOC and Vigilance Clearance by the present employer, or an undertaking as applicable, for candidates applying from Metro Rail/Railway/Railway PSUs/Government Organisation/PSUs
  • Copies of APAR (Annual Performance Appraisal Report) for the last 5 years for the posts of General Manager and Additional General Manager
  • Self-declaration by candidates working on consolidated pay for a Government organisation, confirming they are working/have worked at the level of the post as per the eligibility prescribed

Non-submission of documents as required will lead to rejection of candidature at any stage during the recruitment process. Original documents will need to be shown during the interview or after selection, with two sets of photocopies submitted along with the filled application form at the time of joining.

How to Apply for MPMRCL GM/AGM Civil Recruitment 2026?

The Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has released the Final Answer Key for the Junior Engineer Common Recruitment Examination (JECRE)-2025. The answer key is available for Set A and covers five subject papers: General English, General Studies & Aptitude, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering. This article gives you the complete subject-wise final answers, important notes on grace marks and alternate correct options, and guidance on what to do next.

Examination Name Junior Engineer Common Recruitment Examination (JECRE)-2025

APPSC JE Final Answer Key 2026 - Important Dates

The final answer key document itself does not print the release date or the examination date. Based on APPSC's official notification for the answer key challenge process, here is the confirmed timeline for the provisional stage:

Event Date
Advertisement for JECRE-2025 issued 17 September 2025
Written examination (as rescheduled) 24 January 2026
Provisional answer key (Set A) uploaded 24 January 2026
Last date to submit answer key challenge Till 10:00 AM, 26 January 2026

Note: The final answer key PDF reviewed for this article does not carry a printed release date. Candidates should confirm the exact final-key release date on the official APPSC website.

Vacancy Details

The Junior Engineer Common Recruitment Examination-2025 was conducted for Junior Engineer posts under various Works Departments of the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. According to APPSC's recruitment notification (Advt. No. APPSC/5/2025), the recruitment covers Junior Engineer posts across Civil, Computer/IT, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, and Mechanical disciplines, with 413 posts advertised. The post falls under Group B (Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial), Pay Matrix Level-6. Exact discipline-wise vacancy breakup is not part of the answer key document; refer to the official recruitment notification on appsc.gov.in for the department- and discipline-wise vacancy distribution.

Subject-Wise Final Answer Key Highlights (Set A)

The final answer key lists correct answers for Q.1 to Q.100 in each of the five papers. Below are the specific corrections, alternate-answer allowances, and grace-mark notes printed on the official document.

1. General English, General Studies & Aptitude

All 100 questions have a single final answer listed, with no alternate options or grace marks noted for this paper.

2. Computer Engineering

All 100 questions have a single final answer listed, with no alternate options or grace marks noted for this paper.

3. Electrical Engineering

  • Question 26: Marked as A/B/C - marks are to be awarded for marking any one of the three options.
  • Question 47: Marked with an asterisk (*) - grace marks to be given to all candidates.
  • Question 51: Marked with an asterisk (*) - grace marks to be given to all candidates.

4. Electronics & Communication Engineering

  • Question 88: Marked as A/D - marks are to be awarded for marking either of the two correct options.

5. Mechanical Engineering

All 100 questions have a single final answer listed, with no alternate options or grace marks noted for this paper.

Important Instructions

  • This is the Final Answer Key, issued after the objection/challenge window for the provisional key closed on 26 January 2026.
  • For Electrical Engineering Question 26, candidates who marked A, B, or C are all awarded marks.
  • For Electrical Engineering Questions 47 and 51, grace marks are awarded to all candidates regardless of the option marked.
  • For Electronics & Communication Engineering Question 88, candidates who marked A or D are both awarded marks.
  • The document does not mention any further challenge or objection window against the final answer key. Typically, final answer keys are not open to fresh objections, but candidates should verify this on the official APPSC notice.

How to Download the APPSC JE Final Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official APPSC website: appsc.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Answer Key" section on the homepage or notice board.
  3. Look for "Final Answer Key of Junior Engineer Common Recruitment Examination-2025."
  4. Select and open the relevant subject-wise PDF (General English/GS & Aptitude, Computer, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, or Mechanical Engineering).
  5. Download and save the PDF for reference, or match it against your recorded responses.

How to Download the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories Answer Key 2026?

  1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB region, or use the common portal link.
  2. Look for the notification link titled "CEN No. 08/2025 - Ministerial and Isolated Categories Answer Key 2026" under the Latest Updates or Answer Key/Objection section.

  6. Use the "Save/Print" option to download the answer key and response sheet as a PDF.

How to Calculate Marks Using the RRB MI Answer Key?

The RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories CBT carries 100 marks for 100 questions. Use the following marking scheme to estimate your score:

  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect Answer: -1/3 (0.33) mark deducted
  • Unattempted Question: 0 marks

Formula: Total Marks = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.33)

  3. Select the specific question ID and the answer option you believe is incorrect.
  4. Upload a valid justification or supporting reference (textbook page, authoritative source, etc.) for each challenged question. Objections without proof are not considered.
  5. Pay the objection fee of Rs. 50 per question (plus applicable bank charges) via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking.
  6. Submit the form and save the confirmation/acknowledgement for future reference.

What Is the TNPSC Test Code 006 Departmental Exam?

TNPSC conducts Departmental Examinations for government employees who need to clear specific subject-wise tests as part of service rules, promotions, or eligibility requirements. These are distinct from TNPSC's public recruitment exams (such as Group 1, Group 2, or Group 4), which are open to external candidates and involve vacancies and applications. Test Code 006 refers to one specific objective-type subject paper conducted as part of the May 2026 departmental exam cycle, held alongside other subject papers in objective, descriptive, and combined objective-and-descriptive formats.

  4. The tentative answer key PDF will open or download automatically.
  5. Cross-check your marked responses against the answer key and save a copy for reference.

Details Required to Raise an Objection

Candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the Test Code 006 tentative key must email TNPSC with the following details before the deadline:

  • Copy of the hall ticket (admit card)
  • Register number
  • Name of the exam and Test Code (006)
  • Question number being objected to
  • The answer published by TNPSC in the tentative key
  • The answer the candidate believes is correct
  • Supporting proof or reference material for the claimed correct answer

How to Raise an Objection

  1. Prepare your objection with all required details listed above.
  2. Send your objection by email only to [email protected].
  3. Ensure your email is sent between 31.07.2026 and 06.08.2026, before 5:45 PM.
  4. Do not send objections by post or physical letter TNPSC has confirmed these will not be accepted or considered.

Important Instructions

  • This is a tentative (provisional) answer key, not the final key. TNPSC may revise answers after reviewing objections.
  • Only email objections sent to the official ID within the stated window will be considered.
  • Objections without supporting proof or references may not be taken up for review.
  • This answer key and process apply specifically to Test Code 006 (Objective Type); other subject papers under the same May 2026 departmental exam cycle had their answer keys released separately on 21.07.2026.

  7. Submit the form and download the confirmation receipt.

Once objections close, RPSC's subject expert panel will review all valid challenges. Based on this review, the Commission will release the final answer key, and the final result and merit list will be prepared strictly using the final key, not the provisional one. Objections submitted without valid supporting documents are typically not considered.

How to Raise an Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates who wish to challenge any question or the model answer can submit an objection online during the specified window. The process, as per the official notice, is as follows:

  2. Select the question and/or model answer you wish to object to.
  3. Attach a copy of an authentic source document or proof supporting your objection.
  4. Pay the non-refundable objection fee of ₹50/- per objection through the online payment mode.
  5. Submit the objection before the closing time and retain the confirmation for your records.

  • Objections submitted without authentic proof/source will not be entertained.
  • Objections submitted without payment of the prescribed fee will not be entertained.
  • Objections received after 06.08.2026, 12:00 p.m. will not be entertained.
  • Objections submitted through any mode other than the one prescribed in the official notice will not be entertained.
  • Any objection that does not meet the above conditions will be rejected automatically without assigning any reason.
  • No representation regarding any question or the provisional Model Answer will be entertained after the closing date for objections.
  • If no objection is received for a question, the provisional Model Answer Key will be deemed final for that question.
  • The decision of the High Court of Judicature at Patna on all objections is final, and no further correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to keep visiting the official website regularly for further updates.

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes?

The provisional Model Answer Key will be finalised after the High Court reviews all valid objections received within the window. This finalised key will then be used as the official Model Answer for generating the result of the Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination, 2026. Because this is a scanned document released by the High Court, candidates should always cross-check their answers against the original PDF on the official website rather than relying on any third-party reproduction, to avoid transcription errors.

How to Download the Delhi HJS Model Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the High Court of Delhi: www.delhihighcourt.nic.in
  2. Go to the "Updates" or "Public Notices > Recruitment" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link titled "Notice for uploading of Model Answer Keys and inviting objections thereto in relation to Delhi Higher Judicial Service Preliminary Examination - 2026."
  4. The PDF will open, showing the Model Answer Keys for Series A, B, C and D.
  5. Download and save the PDF, then match it with your question paper series (mentioned on your OMR sheet/admit card).
  6. Calculate your probable score using the marking scheme given below.

How to Raise an Objection Against the Model Answer Key

  1. Visit www.delhihighcourt.nic.in and open the link "Apply online for filing objections to the Model Answer Keys in relation to Delhi Higher Judicial Service Preliminary Examination - 2026."
  2. Log in using the credentials created at the time of application/admit card download.
  3. Select the question number(s) you wish to object to, based on your question paper series.
  4. Choose an answer option other than the one already given in the Model Answer Key.
  5. Enter a valid justification or reason for each objection - this is mandatory and objections without justification may not be considered.
  6. Submit the objection before the deadline of 31 July 2026, 5:00 PM.
  7. Save or take a printout of the submission acknowledgment for future reference.

Documents Required (For Shortlisted Candidates)

Candidates declared successful in the Mains Examination must submit self-attested copies of the following documents within 5 days of the result, along with a covering letter mentioning Roll Number and Application Number:

  • Proof of age (Matriculation certificate or equivalent)
  • Xth and XIIth Class mark sheets and pass certificates
  • LL.B. degree or equivalent law degree, and all semester/consolidated mark sheets
  • Advocate's licence and Bar Council enrolment certificate
  • All India Bar Examination pass certificate (if applicable)
  • Original certificate of practice period, countersigned by the Registrar General/District Judge
  • Employer certificates (for those in service or judicial service, as applicable)
  • Copies of order sheets/judgments where the candidate appeared, for the relevant periods
  • No Objection Certificate from employer (if in government/judicial service)
  • Income Tax Return acknowledgments and Assessment Orders for the years specified in the application
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST candidates) or Disability Certificate (for PwD candidates), where applicable

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The application form must be filled only in English; answers in the examination are also to be given in English, except where the syllabus specifies otherwise.
  • Candidates must carry the downloaded admit card and an original, valid photo ID (Voter ID, Passport, Bar Association ID, Aadhaar, or PAN) to the exam centre. A photo ID shown only on a mobile phone is not accepted.
  • Only a blue or black ball point pen may be used to darken the OMR oval; darkening more than one oval or making any change (including with an eraser or whitener) leads to 0.25 negative marks for that question.
  • The OMR sheet cannot be carried out of the exam hall after the test.
  • Candidates already in government/judicial service, a PSU, or a bank must inform their employer that they have applied, and must submit a No Objection Certificate if selected for Viva-Voce.
  • Canvassing or use of unfair means in any form will result in disqualification.
  • PwD candidates seeking scribe and/or compensatory time facilities must submit the prescribed certificate and notarised affidavit to the Joint Registrar [Examination (Judicial)] at least 3 days before the exam date. Eligible candidates get 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour of exam duration.

How to Raise an Online Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates can follow these steps to submit an objection through the CGPSC website:

  1. Visit the official CGPSC website and log in to the candidate dashboard.
  2. Go to the Activity Section and click on Objection Filing.
  3. On the new page, select the exam name, question paper, set, and the question number you want to object to.
  4. Select the applicable type of objection (see list below).
  5. Clearly write the reason for the objection in the box provided.
  6. Upload supporting proof as a PDF document (maximum size 1MB per question). Proof must include the source name, author, edition/publication date, and reference page number — mere links or website names without this detail will not be accepted.
  7. Use the Add button to submit multiple objections; unwanted entries can be removed before final submission.
  8. Click Save after entering all objections.
  9. Proceed to the fee payment page and click Pay Now to pay Rs. 50 per question for all objections raised.
  10. After successful payment, download the acknowledgement/receipt from the Dashboard under Activity Section > Download Acknowledgement.

Types of Objections Accepted

Objection Type Description
All Answer Options Incorrect All given options for a question are wrong
Commission's Answer Option Incorrect The answer option released by the commission is wrong
More Than One Correct Option More than one answer option is correct
Question is Wrong The question itself is incorrect
Question Out of Syllabus The question is not part of the prescribed syllabus
Hindi-English Translation Mismatch There is a factual difference between the Hindi and English translation of the question

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the online mode; no offline application or document will be accepted at the commission office.
  • Candidates get only one opportunity to submit all objections together; once the fee is paid, the process is considered complete and objections cannot be filed again.
  • Candidates are responsible for avoiding phishing, hacking, or other cyber risks during online banking/payment.
  • If the fee payment is unsuccessful, if entries are made in different sets of the same question paper, or if the prescribed process is not followed correctly, the submitted objection will be automatically rejected, and no request/appeal regarding this will be entertained by the commission.

How to Download the BPSC Assistant Environmental Scientist Final Answer Key

  1. Visit the official BPSC website: bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
  2. Open the "Advertisement" or "Notifications" section and locate Advt. No. 88/2025 - Assistant Environmental Scientist.
  3. Click the "Final Answer Key" link for the relevant paper.
  4. Download the General Studies (Paper-I) key, plus the key for the optional subject (Physics, Chemistry, Life Science, or Environmental Science) you actually appeared for.
  5. Identify your question-booklet series (A, B, C, or D) printed on your OMR/admit card and match it against the correct series column in the PDF.
  6. Save a copy of the PDF for your records before calculating your probable score.

Subject-Wise Final Answer Key Summary

Every paper carries 100 questions. The table below summarizes how many questions were deleted in the final key for each subject, based on the officially released PDFs.

Subject Total Questions Questions Deleted in Final Key Reason Given in Official Key
General Studies (Paper-I) 100 1 (Q1, Series-A) Not specified in the document
Physics (Paper-II, Optional) 100 3 (Q87, Q92, Q99 - Series-A numbering) Not specified in the document
Chemistry (Paper-II, Optional) 100 1 (Q6, Series-A) Printing error in a chemical formula in the question
Life Science (Paper-II, Optional) 100 0 Not applicable
Environmental Science (Paper-II, Optional) 100 2 (Q31, Q46 - Series-A numbering) Multiple correct options / symbol not listed among options

Deleted & Reasoned Questions - Details by Subject

General Studies (Paper-I)

Question 1 in Series-A (corresponding to Q31 in Series-B, Q61 in Series-C, and Q81 in Series-D) has been marked "Deleted" in the final key. No written reason is printed against this entry in the official document; all candidates will receive marks for this question.

Physics (Paper-II, Optional)

Three questions have been deleted in the final Physics key. Using Series-A numbering, these are Q87 (Series-B: 52, Series-C: 67, Series-D: 82), Q92 (Series-B: 57, Series-C: 72, Series-D: 87), and Q99 (Series-B: 64, Series-C: 79, Series-D: 94). The official PDF does not include a reason column for this subject, so no explanation is printed against these deletions.

Chemistry (Paper-II, Optional)

Question 6 in Series-A (Series-B: 21, Series-C: 36, Series-D: 1) has been deleted. The official reason states that the question contained a printing mistake in a chemical formula, which made the question ambiguous, so it has been dropped from evaluation for all candidates.

Life Science (Paper-II, Optional)

No question has been deleted in the Life Science final key. One answer (Series-A Q82) carries an added explanatory note on food-chain trophic levels - producers, primary/secondary consumers, and decomposers - to justify the chosen correct option, but the question itself stands and has not been dropped.

Environmental Science (Paper-II, Optional)

Two questions have been deleted:

  • Series-A Q31 (Series-B: 46, Series-C: 11, Series-D: 26) - deleted because certain districts of Karnataka and Kerala have rainforest cover in addition to the option listed as fully rainforest, creating more than one correct option.
  • Series-A Q46 (Series-B: 11, Series-C: 26, Series-D: 41) - deleted because the correct answer (an animal recognized as the symbol of the World Wildlife Fund) was not present among the listed options.

Two further answers carry explanatory notes without being deleted: one clarifies that decomposers hold the largest population share in a food chain, and another confirms that pH is a logarithmic function in the mathematical sense, supporting an Assertion-Reason type question.

How to Calculate Your Probable Score

Based on the recruitment notification for this post, the written exam consists of Paper-I - General Studies (100 marks) and Paper-II - Optional Subject (300 marks), with 0.33 marks (1/3) deducted for every wrong answer. To estimate your score:

  1. Note your question-booklet series (A/B/C/D) from your admit card.
  2. Match each of your recorded responses against the correct answer in that series column of the final key.
  3. Award full marks for every correct match.
  4. Deduct 0.33 marks for every incorrect match.
  5. Treat questions marked "Deleted" as correct for all candidates, regardless of the option chosen or left unattempted.

Important Instructions

  • The released document is the final answer key, issued after review of objections raised against the provisional key (objection window: 08 July 2026 to 12 July 2026).
  • Match your answers only against the series (A/B/C/D) printed on your own question booklet - answers differ by series even though the underlying questions are the same.
  • Questions marked "Deleted" are treated as correct for every candidate and do not require any action from candidates.
  • Download the General Studies key along with only the optional subject you actually appeared for.
  • Refer to the official BPSC website for the result date and further updates, as this is not mentioned in the final answer key documents.

  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

  • Company: Lenskart

  • Compensation: ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 /year
  • Experience: No experience required
Key Skills
MultitaskingProblem SolvingClient RelationshipEnglish Proficiency (Spoken)English Proficiency (Written)AdaptabilitySales
Role Snapshot
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. Key responsibilities: A. Customer focus: 1. Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up. 2. He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers. 3. He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively. 4. He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has. B. Product recommendation: 1. With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales. 2. He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions. C. Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence: 1. Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently. 2. Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage. D. Store upkeep & maintenance: 1. He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly. 2. He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Note: This role requires working 6 days a week with a rotational week-off and rotational shifts based on business requirements. Please note that there are no night shifts. Training information: Candidates selected for the role after successfully completing the interview process will be attending a one month mandatory offline training program at a designated Lenskart Academy, which is an integral part of the onboarding process. Performance-based incentives will be provided

About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

About Viva Wellness Drip

We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.

Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.

Business Operations

  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred

  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.

It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.

I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.

It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.

There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips

Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.

Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?

Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?

Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.

Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.
